Our results, on seven clinically vital predictive tasks, show that tree-based methods, particularly XGBoost, consistently achieved the most stable performance across imbalance levels and scaled efficiently with sample size. Deep tabular models degraded more sharply under imbalance and incurred higher computational costs, while TabResNet provided a lighter alternative to TabNet but did not surpass ensemble benchmarks. These findings indicate that in emergency and critical care, robustness to imbalance and computational scalability could outweigh architectural complexity. Tree-based ensemble methods currently offer the most practical and clinically feasible choice, equipping practitioners with a framework for selecting models suited to high-stakes, time-sensitive environments.

AI.title_translation: 机器学习在紧急和危重护理中处理不平衡临床数据的鲁棒性与可扩展性
AI.tldr: 在紧急和重症监护的严重不平衡临床数据上，XGBoost等基于树的模型在鲁棒性和计算效率方面优于深度学习模型（如TabNet和TabResNet）。对于高风险、时间敏感的环境，应优先选择稳定且高效的集成树模型。
AI.motivation: 紧急和重症监护环境需要准确且计算效率高的预测模型，但临床数据通常存在严重不平衡，这损害了模型可靠性，特别是对于罕见但临床上重要的结果，因此对鲁棒性和可扩展性有必要性。
AI.method: 系统评估了经典机器学习模型（特别是基于树的方法）、TabNet和定制的轻量级残差网络TabResNet在MIMIC-IV-ED和eICU的严重不平衡表格数据上的鲁棒性和可扩展性。使用互补指标量化了类别不平衡，并通过贝叶斯超参数搜索优化了所有模型。评估了它们在预测性能、对不平衡增加的鲁棒性以及计算可扩展性方面的表现。TabResNet通过简化的残差架构替代了TabNet的注意力机制进行设计。
AI.result: 基于树的方法（尤其是XGBoost）在所有不平衡水平上持续实现了最稳定的性能，并能有效地随样本量扩展。深度表格模型在不平衡情况下性能下降更明显，且计算成本更高。TabResNet是TabNet的更轻量级替代方案，但未超过集成基准模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，在紧急和危重护理中，对不平衡的鲁棒性和计算可扩展性可能比架构复杂性更重要。基于树的集成方法目前提供了最实用和临床可行的选择，为实践者提供了一个选择适合高风险、时间敏感环境模型的框架。
AI.translation: 紧急和重症监护环境需要既准确又计算效率高的预测模型，但这些环境中的临床数据通常严重不平衡。这种倾斜会损害模型的可靠性，特别是对于罕见但临床上至关重要的结果，使得鲁棒性和可扩展性对实际应用至关重要。在本文中，我们系统地评估了经典机器学习模型在MIMIC-IV-ED和eICU的不平衡表格数据上的鲁棒性和可扩展性。使用互补指标量化了类别不平衡，并比较了基于树的方法、最先进的TabNet深度学习模型和定制的轻量级残差网络（TabResNet）的性能。TabResNet被设计为TabNet的计算高效替代方案，用简化的残差架构取代了其复杂的注意力机制，以保持对实时临床使用的表征能力。所有模型都通过贝叶斯超参数搜索进行了优化，并在预测性能、对不平衡增加的鲁棒性以及计算可扩展性方面进行了评估。我们在七项临床关键预测任务上的结果表明，基于树的方法，特别是XGBoost，在所有不平衡水平上持续实现了最稳定的性能，并能有效地随样本量扩展。深度表格模型在不平衡情况下下降更剧烈，并产生更高的计算成本，而TabResNet为TabNet提供了一个更轻的替代方案，但并未超越集成基准。这些发现表明，在紧急和危重护理中，对不平衡的鲁棒性和计算可扩展性可能比架构复杂性更重要。基于树的集成方法目前提供了最实用和临床可行的选择，为实践者提供了一个选择适合高风险、时间敏感环境模型的框架。
AI.summary: 本研究系统评估了经典机器学习模型、TabNet和轻量级残差网络TabResNet在处理MIMIC-IV-ED和eICU等严重不平衡的紧急和重症监护临床数据时的鲁棒性和可扩展性。结果显示，基于树的方法（如XGBoost）在处理不平衡和扩展性方面表现出最稳定的性能和最高的计算效率。研究得出结论，在时间敏感的临床环境中，模型对不平衡的鲁棒性和计算可扩展性比复杂的架构更为关键，推荐使用基于树的集成方法。
AI.keywords: 不平衡数据, 紧急护理, 可扩展性, 鲁棒性, 树模型
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于系统地比较了不同模型（传统ML、TabNet、轻量级残差网络TabResNet）在处理严重不平衡的临床数据时的鲁棒性和可扩展性，并提出了一个针对实时临床应用优化的TabResNet。研究强调了在紧急和危重护理环境中，对不平衡的鲁棒性和计算可扩展性比模型架构的复杂性更重要。

title: A Data-Driven Multi-Objective Approach for Predicting Mechanical Performance, Flowability, and Porosity in Ultra-High-Performance Concrete (UHPC)
summary: This study presents a data-driven, multi-objective approach to predict the mechanical performance, flow ability, and porosity of Ultra-High-Performance Concrete (UHPC). Out of 21 machine learning algorithms tested, five high-performing models are selected, with XGBoost showing the best accuracy after hyperparameter tuning using Random Search and K-Fold Cross-Validation. The framework follows a two-stage process: the initial XGBoost model is built using raw data, and once selected as the final model, the dataset is cleaned by (1) removing multicollinear features, (2) identifying outliers with Isolation Forest, and (3) selecting important features using SHAP analysis. The refined dataset as model 2 is then used to retrain XGBoost, which achieves high prediction accuracy across all outputs. A graphical user interface (GUI) is also developed to support material designers. Overall, the proposed framework significantly improves the prediction accuracy and minimizes the need for extensive experimental testing in UHPC mix design.

AI.title_translation: 超高韧性混凝土（UHPC）力学性能、流动性和孔隙率预测的数据驱动多目标方法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种数据驱动的多目标方法来预测超高韧性混凝土（UHPC）的力学性能、流动性和孔隙率。通过对比21种机器学习算法，并结合超参数调优和数据集精炼，最终采用XGBoost模型实现了高预测精度，并开发了图形用户界面（GUI）以辅助材料设计，从而减少了实验测试需求。
AI.motivation: 为了提高超高韧性混凝土（UHPC）的力学性能、流动性和孔隙率预测的准确性，并减少实验测试的需要。
AI.method: 采用数据驱动的多目标方法，首先测试了21种机器学习算法，并选择了5种表现最佳的模型。通过随机搜索和K折交叉验证进行超参数调优后，XGBoost模型表现出最佳的准确性。该框架分两个阶段进行：第一阶段使用原始数据构建XGBoost模型；第二阶段在选定最终模型后，通过移除多重共线性特征、使用Isolation Forest识别异常值以及利用SHAP分析选择重要特征来清理数据集，然后重新训练XGBoost模型。
AI.result: 经过超参数调优和数据集精炼后，XGBoost模型在所有输出上都实现了高预测精度。此外，还开发了一个图形用户界面（GUI）来支持材料设计。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的数据驱动多目标方法，通过XGBoost模型和数据集精炼策略，显著提高了UHPC性能预测的准确性，并能最小化实验测试需求，为UHPC的混合料设计提供了有效支持。
AI.translation: 本研究提出了一种数据驱动、多目标的方法，用于预测超高韧性混凝土（UHPC）的力学性能、流动性和孔隙率。在测试的21种机器学习算法中，选择了五种高性能模型，其中XGBoost在通过随机搜索和K折交叉验证进行超参数调整后表现出最佳的准确性。该框架遵循一个两阶段的过程：初始XGBoost模型使用原始数据构建，一旦被选为最终模型，数据集将通过（1）移除多重共线性特征、（2）使用Isolation Forest识别异常值以及（3）使用SHAP分析选择重要特征进行清理。精炼后的数据集作为模型2，然后用于重新训练XGBoost，该模型在所有输出上都实现了高预测精度。此外，还开发了一个图形用户界面（GUI）来支持材料设计者。总的来说，所提出的框架显著提高了预测精度，并最大限度地减少了UHPC混合料设计中广泛的实验测试需求。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的数据驱动多目标方法，利用XGBoost模型预测超高韧性混凝土（UHPC）的力学性能、流动性和孔隙率。通过严谨的数据预处理和模型优化流程，包括特征选择和异常值检测，该方法显著提高了预测精度，并开发了易于使用的图形用户界面（GUI），旨在减少UHPC混合料设计的实验工作量。
AI.keywords: 超高韧性混凝土, 数据驱动, 多目标优化, XGBoost, 预测模型
AI.comments: 该研究在UHPC性能预测方面具有重要意义，通过数据驱动的方法和先进的机器学习技术，有效提高了预测精度并简化了设计流程。然而，其泛化能力和在不同UHPC配方下的适用性仍需进一步验证。

title: AMS-IO-Bench and AMS-IO-Agent: Benchmarking and Structured Reasoning for Analog and Mixed-Signal Integrated Circuit Input/Output Design
summary: In this paper, we propose AMS-IO-Agent, a domain-specialized LLM-based agent for structure-aware input/output (I/O) subsystem generation in analog and mixed-signal (AMS) integrated circuits (ICs). The central contribution of this work is a framework that connects natural language design intent with industrial-level AMS IC design deliverables. AMS-IO-Agent integrates two key capabilities: (1) a structured domain knowledge base that captures reusable constraints and design conventions; (2) design intent structuring, which converts ambiguous user intent into verifiable logic steps using JSON and Python as intermediate formats. We further introduce AMS-IO-Bench, a benchmark for wirebond-packaged AMS I/O ring automation. On this benchmark, AMS-IO-Agent achieves over 70\% DRC+LVS pass rate and reduces design turnaround time from hours to minutes, outperforming the baseline LLM. Furthermore, an agent-generated I/O ring was fabricated and validated in a 28 nm CMOS tape-out, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of the approach in real AMS IC design flows. To our knowledge, this is the first reported human-agent collaborative AMS IC design in which an LLM-based agent completes a nontrivial subtask with outputs directly used in silicon.

AI.title_translation: AMS-IO-Bench和AMS-IO-Agent：用于模拟和混合信号集成电路输入/输出设计的基准测试和结构化推理
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一个名为AMS-IO-Agent的专业LLM智能体，用于自动化生成AMS IC的I/O子系统，它使用结构化知识和JSON/Python逻辑来理解设计意图。通过新的基准测试AMS-IO-Bench，该智能体在效率和设计正确性上表现出色，并且其设计成果已在28nm芯片中成功流片，是首个在实际IC设计中完成非平凡子任务的LLM驱动系统。
AI.motivation: 旨在弥合自然语言设计意图与工业级模拟和混合信号集成电路（AMS IC）设计交付物之间的差距，实现AMS IC输入/输出（I/O）子系统的结构感知生成自动化。
AI.method: 提出AMS-IO-Agent，一个集成结构化领域知识库（捕获约束和设计规范）和设计意图结构化能力（将自然语言意图转化为JSON和Python逻辑步骤）的领域专业LLM智能体。同时引入AMS-IO-Bench基准测试来评估其性能。
AI.result: AMS-IO-Agent在AMS-IO-Bench上实现了超过70%的DRC+LVS通过率，并将设计周转时间从数小时缩短到数分钟，优于基线LLM。生成的I/O环在28nm CMOS工艺中成功流片并得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的AMS-IO-Agent和AMS-IO-Bench在实际AMS IC设计流程中展示了显著的实用性和效率提升，实现了LLM驱动的AMS IC设计的首次人机协作，并在28nm CMOS工艺中成功流片验证。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了AMS-IO-Agent，一个领域专业化的基于LLM的智能体，用于模拟和混合信号（AMS）集成电路（IC）中结构感知的输入/输出（I/O）子系统的生成。这项工作的核心贡献是一个将自然语言设计意图与工业级AMS IC设计交付物连接起来的框架。AMS-IO-Agent集成了两个关键能力：（1）捕获可重用约束和设计惯例的结构化领域知识库；（2）设计意图结构化，它使用JSON和Python作为中间格式，将模糊的用户意图转化为可验证的逻辑步骤。我们进一步引入了AMS-IO-Bench，一个用于线键合封装的AMS I/O环自动化的基准测试。在该基准测试上，AMS-IO-Agent实现了超过70%的DRC+LVS通过率，并将设计周转时间从数小时减少到数分钟，优于基线LLM。此外，一个由智能体生成的I/O环在28nm CMOS流片中被制造和验证，证明了该方法在真实AMS IC设计流程中的实用有效性。据我们所知，这是首次报道的人机协作AMS IC设计，其中基于LLM的智能体完成了一个非平凡的子任务，其输出被直接用于硅片制造。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AMS-IO-Agent，一个用于模拟和混合信号集成电路（AMS IC）I/O子系统生成的领域专业LLM智能体。该智能体通过集成结构化知识库和将设计意图转化为可验证的JSON/Python逻辑步骤的能力，实现了自然语言设计意图到工业级交付物的连接。同时，引入了AMS-IO-Bench基准测试，结果显示AMS-IO-Agent显著提高了设计效率并通过了实际硅片验证，标志着LLM在实际IC设计中的首次成功应用。
AI.keywords: AMS IC设计, I/O子系统生成, LLM智能体, 基准测试, 结构化推理
AI.comments: 该工作的创新性在于首次将基于LLM的智能体应用于模拟和混合信号集成电路（AMS IC）设计的关键子任务——输入/输出（I/O）子系统的自动化生成，并成功在28nm工艺中流片验证，实现了人机协作在实际IC设计中的首次落地。其重要性在于极大地缩短了设计时间，并提供了一个可复用的、结构化的设计框架。局限性可能在于当前仅专注于I/O环设计，通用性有待进一步验证。

title: Embedding Samples Dispatching for Recommendation Model Training in Edge Environments
comments: This paper is an English version of Samples Dispatching Mechanism for Accelerating Recommendation Model Training in Edge Intelligent Computing System published in 2025 in the Journal of Computer Research and Development
summary: Training deep learning recommendation models (DLRMs) on edge workers brings several benefits, particularly in terms of data privacy protection, low latency and personalization. However, due to the huge size of embedding tables, typical DLRM training frameworks adopt one or more parameter servers to maintain global embedding tables, while leveraging the edge workers cache part of them. This incurs significant transmission cost for embedding transmissions between workers and parameter servers, which can dominate the training cycle. In this paper, we investigate how to dispatch input embedding samples to appropriate edge workers to minimize the total embedding transmission cost when facing edge-specific challenges such as heterogeneous networks and limited resources. We develop ESD, a novel mechanism that optimizes the dispatch of input embedding samples to edge workers based on expected embedding transmission cost. We propose HybridDis as the dispatch decision method within ESD, which combines a resource-intensive optimal algorithm and a heuristic algorithm to balance decision quality and resource consumption. We implement a prototype of ESD and compare it with state-of-the-art mechanisms on real-world workloads. Extensive experimental results show that ESD reduces the embedding transmission cost by up to 36.76% and achieves up to 1.74 times speedup in end-to-end DLRM training.
comment: This paper is an English version of Samples Dispatching Mechanism for Accelerating Recommendation Model Training in Edge Intelligent Computing System published in 2025 in the Journal of Computer Research and Development

AI.title_translation: 边缘环境下推荐模型训练的嵌入样本调度
AI.tldr: 为了解决边缘环境中训练深度学习推荐模型时嵌入传输成本过高的问题，本文提出了ESD调度机制，它通过智能地将输入嵌入样本分配给合适的边缘工作站，显著降低了传输开销（最高降幅36.76%）并加快了训练速度（最高加速1.74倍）。
AI.motivation: 在边缘工作站训练深度学习推荐模型（DLRM）虽然在数据隐私、低延迟和个性化方面有益，但由于嵌入表巨大，参数服务器与工作站之间的数据传输成本会主导训练周期。因此，研究如何调度输入嵌入样本以最小化总传输成本是必要的。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为ESD（Embedding Samples Dispatching）的新机制，该机制基于预期的嵌入传输成本来优化输入嵌入样本到边缘工作站的调度。ESD内部采用HybridDis作为调度决策方法，它结合了一个资源密集型的最优算法和一个启发式算法，以平衡决策质量和资源消耗。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ESD将嵌入传输成本降低了高达36.76%，并将端到端DLRM训练的速度提高了1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: ESD通过优化输入嵌入样本的调度，成功地最小化了边缘环境中DLRM训练的总嵌入传输成本，并在实际工作负载上实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 在边缘工作站上训练深度学习推荐模型（DLRM）在数据隐私保护、低延迟和个性化方面带来了诸多好处。然而，由于嵌入表尺寸巨大，典型的DLRM训练框架采用一个或多个参数服务器来维护全局嵌入表，同时利用边缘工作站缓存其中的一部分。这在工作站和参数服务器之间引入了大量的嵌入传输成本，可能主导整个训练周期。在本文中，我们研究了如何在面对边缘特有的挑战（如异构网络和有限资源）时，调度输入嵌入样本到合适的边缘工作站，以最小化总嵌入传输成本。我们开发了ESD，一种新颖的机制，它基于预期的嵌入传输成本来优化输入嵌入样本到边缘工作站的调度。我们提出了HybridDis作为ESD中的调度决策方法，它结合了一个资源密集型的最优算法和一个启发式算法，以平衡决策质量和资源消耗。我们实现了ESD的原型，并在真实世界的工作负载上与最先进的机制进行了比较。广泛的实验结果表明，ESD将嵌入传输成本降低了高达36.76%，并将端到端DLRM训练的速度提高了1.74倍。
AI.summary: 本文针对在边缘环境中训练深度学习推荐模型（DLRM）时，因嵌入表传输导致的巨大开销问题，提出了一种名为ESD的新型嵌入样本调度机制。ESD通过基于预期传输成本优化样本调度，并采用HybridDis方法平衡决策质量与资源消耗，从而有效降低了嵌入传输成本并加速了端到端训练过程。
AI.keywords: 嵌入样本调度, 推荐模型训练, 边缘环境, 传输成本, DLRM
AI.comments: 该论文针对在边缘环境中训练深度学习推荐模型（DLRM）时嵌入表传输成本高昂的问题，提出了ESD机制，该机制通过优化输入嵌入样本的调度来解决异构网络和资源限制等边缘挑战。其创新点在于结合了最优算法和启发式算法（HybridDis）来平衡决策质量和资源消耗。该方法在实际工作负载上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: TAMEing Long Contexts in Personalization: Towards Training-Free and State-Aware MLLM Personalized Assistant
comments: Accepted by KDD 2026 research track. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ronpay/TAME
summary: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) Personalization is a critical research problem that facilitates personalized dialogues with MLLMs targeting specific entities (known as personalized concepts). However, existing methods and benchmarks focus on the simple, context-agnostic visual identification and textual replacement of the personalized concept (e.g., "A yellow puppy" -> "Your puppy Mochi"), overlooking the ability to support long-context conversations. An ideal personalized MLLM assistant is capable of engaging in long-context dialogues with humans and continually improving its experience quality by learning from past dialogue histories. To bridge this gap, we propose LCMP, the first Long-Context MLLM Personalization evaluation benchmark. LCMP assesses the capability of MLLMs in perceiving variations of personalized concepts and generating contextually appropriate personalized responses that reflect these variations. As a strong baseline for LCMP, we introduce a novel training-free and state-aware framework TAME. TAME endows MLLMs with double memories to manage the temporal and persistent variations of each personalized concept in a differentiated manner. In addition, TAME incorporates a new training-free Retrieve-then-Align Augmented Generation (RA2G) paradigm. RA2G introduces an alignment step to extract the contextually fitted information from the multi-memory retrieved knowledge to the current questions, enabling better interactions for complex real-world user queries. Experiments on LCMP demonstrate that TAME achieves the best performance, showcasing remarkable and evolving interaction experiences in long-context scenarios.
comment: Accepted by KDD 2026 research track. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ronpay/TAME

AI.title_translation: 长上下文个性化中的TAME：迈向免训练和状态感知多模态大语言模型个性化助手
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了LCMP，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在长上下文对话中个性化概念处理能力的基准。同时，提出了一种名为TAME的免训练、状态感知框架，通过双重记忆机制和RA2G范式来处理个性化概念的长期和短期变化，并在LCMP基准上取得了最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM个性化方法在处理长上下文对话和根据历史信息持续改进方面存在不足，无法支持个性化概念的长期和短期变化。
AI.method: 提出LCMP评估基准，并引入TAME框架。TAME采用双重记忆机制来区分处理个性化概念的长期和短期变化，并结合RA2G范式，通过检索和对齐来提取相关信息以增强生成能力。
AI.result: 在LCMP基准上，TAME框架取得了最佳性能，展示了在长上下文场景下卓越且不断发展的交互体验。
AI.conclusion: TAME框架通过其创新的双重记忆机制和RA2G范式，成功解决了MLLM在长上下文个性化中的挑战，能够处理个性化概念的长期和短期变化，并在长对话中提供更好的用户体验。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）个性化是一个关键的研究问题，旨在实现针对特定实体（称为个性化概念）的MLLM个性化对话。然而，现有方法和基准侧重于对个性化概念进行简单的、与上下文无关的视觉识别和文本替换（例如，“一只黄色的幼犬”->“你的幼犬Mochi”），而忽略了支持长上下文对话的能力。理想的个性化MLLM助手应能够与人类进行长上下文对话，并通过从过去的对话历史中学习来持续改进其体验质量。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了LCMP，这是第一个长上下文MLLM个性化评估基准。LCMP评估MLLM感知个性化概念的变化并生成反映这些变化的上下文适当的个性化响应的能力。作为LCMP的一个强有力基线，我们引入了一种新颖的免训练和状态感知框架TAME。TAME赋予MLLM双重记忆，以差异化的方式管理每个个性化概念的时间和持久变化。此外，TAME还引入了一个新的免训练检索后对齐增强生成（RA2G）范式。RA2G引入了一个对齐步骤，以从多重记忆检索到的知识中提取适合当前问题的上下文信息，从而能够更好地处理复杂的真实世界用户查询。LCMP上的实验表明，TAME取得了最佳性能，在长上下文场景中展示了卓越且不断发展的交互体验。
AI.summary: 本研究针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在长上下文对话中的个性化能力不足的问题，提出了LCMP评估基准和TAME框架。TAME框架通过引入双重记忆机制来区分处理个性化概念的时间和持久变化，并结合RA2G范式，实现了免训练、状态感知的个性化助手，显著提升了MLLM在长上下文场景下的交互体验。
AI.keywords: 多模态大语言模型, 个性化, 长上下文, 免训练, 状态感知
AI.comments: 该研究在MLLM个性化领域取得了重要进展，特别是通过提出LCMP基准和TAME框架解决了长上下文处理的难题。TAME的双重记忆机制和RA2G范式具有创新性，为未来研究提供了有价值的方向。然而，其在真实世界大规模部署的效率和可扩展性仍有待进一步验证。

title: CausalFSFG: Rethinking Few-Shot Fine-Grained Visual Categorization from Causal Perspective
comments: 12 pages, 5 figures, accepted by IEEE TMM
summary: Few-shot fine-grained visual categorization (FS-FGVC) focuses on identifying various subcategories within a common superclass given just one or few support examples. Most existing methods aim to boost classification accuracy by enriching the extracted features with discriminative part-level details. However, they often overlook the fact that the set of support samples acts as a confounding variable, which hampers the FS-FGVC performance by introducing biased data distribution and misguiding the extraction of discriminative features. To address this issue, we propose a new causal FS-FGVC (CausalFSFG) approach inspired by causal inference for addressing biased data distributions through causal intervention. Specifically, based on the structural causal model (SCM), we argue that FS-FGVC infers the subcategories (i.e., effect) from the inputs (i.e., cause), whereas both the few-shot condition disturbance and the inherent fine-grained nature (i.e., large intra-class variance and small inter-class variance) lead to unobservable variables that bring spurious correlations, compromising the final classification performance. To further eliminate the spurious correlations, our CausalFSFG approach incorporates two key components: (1) Interventional multi-scale encoder (IMSE) conducts sample-level interventions, (2) Interventional masked feature reconstruction (IMFR) conducts feature-level interventions, which together reveal real causalities from inputs to subcategories. Extensive experiments and thorough analyses on the widely-used public datasets, including CUB-200-2011, Stanford Dogs, and Stanford Cars, demonstrate that our CausalFSFG achieves new state-of-the-art performance. The code is available at https://github.com/PKU-ICST-MIPL/CausalFSFG_TMM.
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, accepted by IEEE TMM

AI.title_translation: 因果视角下的少样本细粒度视觉分类：重新思考CausalFSFG
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为CausalFSFG的新方法，用于解决少样本细粒度视觉分类（FS-FGVC）问题。该方法从因果推断的角度出发，通过引入样本级和特征级的因果干预来消除由支持样本引入的混淆变量和虚假相关性，从而提高分类性能。实验结果表明，CausalFSFG在多个公开数据集上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的少样本细粒度视觉分类（FS-FGVC）方法主要通过丰富特征中的判别性局部细节来提高分类准确性，但忽略了支持样本集作为一个混淆变量，它会引入有偏的数据分布并误导判别性特征的提取，从而阻碍了FS-FGVC的性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为CausalFSFG的新方法，该方法受因果推断的启发，通过因果干预来解决有偏的数据分布问题。具体来说，CausalFSFG包含两个关键组件：（1）样本级干预的互联多尺度编码器（IMSE），（2）特征级干预的互联掩码特征重建（IMFR），共同揭示从输入到子类别的真实因果关系。
AI.result: 在CUB-200-2011、Stanford Dogs和Stanford Cars等广泛使用的公共数据集上进行的大量实验和深入分析表明，CausalFSFG取得了新的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了一种新颖的因果FS-FGVC（CausalFSFG）方法，通过引入样本级和特征级的因果干预，有效地解决了支持样本集作为混淆变量带来的数据分布偏差和虚假相关性问题，从而在FS-FGVC任务上取得了优异的性能，达到了新的最先进水平。
AI.translation: 少样本细粒度视觉分类（FS-FGVC）着眼于在仅有一个或几个支持示例的情况下，识别一个常见超类中的各种子类别。大多数现有方法旨在通过丰富提取的特征与判别性部分级细节来提高分类准确性。然而，它们常常忽略了一个事实：支持样本集充当了一个混淆变量，它通过引入有偏的数据分布和误导判别性特征的提取来阻碍FS-FGVC的性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新的因果FS-FGVC（CausalFSFG）方法，该方法受到因果推断的启发，通过因果干预来解决有偏的数据分布问题。具体来说，基于结构因果模型（SCM），我们认为FS-FGVC从输入（即原因）推断子类别（即结果），而少样本条件扰动和固有的细粒度性质（即大的类内方差和小类间方差）会导致不可观察的变量，从而带来虚假相关性，损害最终的分类性能。为了进一步消除虚假相关性，我们的CausalFSFG方法包含两个关键组件：（1）互联多尺度编码器（IMSE）进行样本级干预，（2）互联掩码特征重建（IMFR）进行特征级干预，两者共同揭示从输入到子类别的真实因果关系。在广泛使用的公共数据集，包括CUB-200-2011、Stanford Dogs和Stanford Cars上进行的大量实验和深入分析表明，我们的CausalFSFG取得了新的最先进性能。代码可在https://github.com/PKU-ICST-MIPL/CausalFSFG_TMM获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为CausalFSFG的新方法，用于解决少样本细粒度视觉分类（FS-FGVC）问题。该方法从因果推断的角度出发，通过引入样本级和特征级的因果干预来消除由支持样本引入的混淆变量和虚假相关性，从而提高分类性能。实验结果表明，CausalFSFG在多个公开数据集上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 少样本细粒度视觉分类, 因果推断, 混淆变量, 虚假相关性, 因果干预
AI.comments: 该研究从因果推断的角度切入少样本细粒度视觉分类问题，提出了一种新颖的干预机制来解决混淆变量和虚假相关性问题，具有一定的创新性。提出的IMSE和IMFR组件分别在样本级和特征级进行干预，思路清晰。然而，模型复杂度、计算成本以及在不同类型数据上的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: SymDrive: Realistic and Controllable Driving Simulator via Symmetric Auto-regressive Online Restoration
summary: High-fidelity and controllable 3D simulation is essential for addressing the long-tail data scarcity in Autonomous Driving (AD), yet existing methods struggle to simultaneously achieve photorealistic rendering and interactive traffic editing. Current approaches often falter in large-angle novel view synthesis and suffer from geometric or lighting artifacts during asset manipulation. To address these challenges, we propose SymDrive, a unified diffusion-based framework capable of joint high-quality rendering and scene editing. We introduce a Symmetric Auto-regressive Online Restoration paradigm, which constructs paired symmetric views to recover fine-grained details via a ground-truth-guided dual-view formulation and utilizes an auto-regressive strategy for consistent lateral view generation. Furthermore, we leverage this restoration capability to enable a training-free harmonization mechanism, treating vehicle insertion as context-aware inpainting to ensure seamless lighting and shadow consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SymDrive achieves state-of-the-art performance in both novel-view enhancement and realistic 3D vehicle insertion.

AI.title_translation: SymDrive：通过对称自回归在线恢复实现的真实可控驾驶模拟器
AI.tldr: SymDrive是一个基于扩散模型的新型驾驶模拟器，通过对称自回归在线恢复技术，实现了高质量渲染和交互式场景编辑，解决了现有方法在视角合成和资产编辑中的问题，并在新视角增强和车辆插入方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶（AD）模拟器在同时实现照片级真实感渲染和交互式交通编辑方面存在困难，尤其是在大角度新视角合成以及资产操作时的几何或光照伪影问题。为了解决数据稀缺的长期尾部问题，需要高保真和可控的3D模拟。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为SymDrive的统一的、基于扩散模型的框架，集成了高质量渲染和场景编辑。该框架引入了对称自回归在线恢复范式，通过构建对称视图对，利用以真实图像为指导的双视图公式恢复细节，并通过自回归策略生成一致的侧视图。此外，利用此恢复能力实现了一种无需训练的协调机制，将车辆插入视为上下文感知修复，以确保光照和阴影的一致性。
AI.result: SymDrive在新型视角增强和逼真的3D车辆插入方面均取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: SymDrive通过对称自回归在线恢复范式，成功地实现了高保真渲染和场景编辑的统一，解决了现有方法的局限性，并在自动驾驶模拟的关键任务上取得了优异成果。
AI.translation: 高保真和可控的3D模拟对于解决自动驾驶（AD）中的长尾数据稀缺性至关重要，但现有方法在同时实现照片级真实感渲染和交互式交通编辑方面存在困难。当前的方法通常在大角度新视角合成方面表现不佳，并在资产操作期间出现几何或光照伪影。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SymDrive，一个统一的、基于扩散模型的框架，能够进行联合高质量渲染和场景编辑。我们引入了对称自回归在线恢复范式，该范式构建成对的对称视图以通过以真实图像为指导的双视图公式恢复细粒度细节，并利用自回归策略进行一致的横向视图生成。此外，我们利用这种恢复能力来实现无需训练的协调机制，将车辆插入视为上下文感知修复，以确保无缝的光照和阴影一致性。大量实验表明，SymDrive在新型视角增强和逼真的3D车辆插入方面均取得了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: SymDrive是一个创新的驾驶模拟器，它利用对称自回归在线恢复技术，通过生成成对的对称视图并结合自回归策略，实现了高质量的3D场景渲染和编辑。该方法解决了现有模拟器在大角度视角合成和资产编辑中的不足，并通过无需训练的协调机制实现了光照和阴影的一致性，在车辆插入等任务中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 驾驶模拟, 扩散模型, 对称自回归, 在线恢复, 场景编辑
AI.comments: SymDrive在解决自动驾驶模拟中的数据稀缺问题方面取得了显著进展，其创新的对称自回归在线恢复范式为实现高保真渲染和可控编辑提供了新的思路。然而，该方法在处理极端视角或复杂交通场景时的鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Democratizing Drug Discovery with an Orchestrated, Knowledge-Driven Multi-Agent Team for User-Guided Therapeutic Design
summary: Therapeutic discovery remains a formidable challenge, impeded by the fragmentation of specialized domains and the execution gap between computational design and physiological validation. Although generative AI offers promise, current models often function as passive assistants rather than as autonomous executors. Here, we introduce OrchestRA, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent platform that unifies biology, chemistry, and pharmacology into an autonomous discovery engine. Unlike static code generators, our agents actively execute simulations and reason the results to drive iterative optimization. Governed by an Orchestrator, a Biologist Agent leverages deep reasoning over a massive knowledge graph (>10 million associations) to pinpoint high-confidence targets; a Chemist Agent autonomously detects structural pockets for de novo design or drug repositioning; and a Pharmacologist Agent evaluates candidates via rigorous physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) simulations. This architecture establishes a dynamic feedback loop where pharmacokinetic and toxicity profiles directly trigger structural reoptimization. By seamlessly integrating autonomous execution with human guidance, OrchestRA democratizes therapeutic design, transforming drug discovery from a stochastic search to a programmable evidence-based engineering discipline.

AI.title_translation: 通过一个编排化的、知识驱动的多智能体团队实现用户指导的治疗设计的药物发现民主化
AI.tldr: Orchestra是一个由AI智能体（生物学家、化学家、药理学家）组成的团队，由人类指导，可以自主地、基于知识地、通过模拟验证来设计药物，解决了当前AI被动和设计验证脱节的问题。
AI.motivation: 药物发现是一个艰巨的挑战，受限于专业领域的碎片化以及计算设计与生理验证之间的执行差距。当前生成式AI模型通常是作为被动的助手而非自主的执行者。
AI.method: 引入Orchestra，一个“人在回路”的多智能体平台，集成了生物学、化学和药理学。它包括一个编排者（Orchestrator），一个生物学家智能体（利用知识图谱确定靶点），一个化学家智能体（进行从头设计或老药新用），以及一个药理学家智能体（通过PBPK模拟评估候选药物）。系统通过动态反馈循环实现迭代优化。
AI.result: 该架构建立了一个动态反馈回路，其中药代动力学和毒性特征直接触发结构再优化，实现了自主执行与人类指导的无缝集成。
AI.conclusion: Orchestra通过无缝集成自主执行和人类指导，将药物发现从随机搜索转变为可编程的循证工程学科。
AI.translation: 治疗发现仍然是一个艰巨的挑战，受到专业领域碎片化和计算设计与生理验证之间执行差距的阻碍。尽管生成式人工智能提供了希望，但目前的模型通常充当被动的助手而不是自主的执行者。在这里，我们引入Orchestra，一个“人在回路”的多智能体平台，将生物学、化学和药理学统一到一个自主的发现引擎中。与静态代码生成器不同，我们的智能体主动执行模拟并推理结果以驱动迭代优化。在编排者的指导下，生物学家智能体利用对大型知识图谱（>1000万个关联）的深度推理来确定高置信度的靶点；化学家智能体自主检测结构口袋以进行从头设计或药物重定位；药理学家智能体通过严格的基于生理学的药代动力学（PBPK）模拟来评估候选药物。该架构建立了一个动态反馈回路，其中药代动力学和毒性特征直接触发结构再优化。通过无缝集成自主执行和人类指导，Orchestra使治疗设计民主化，将药物发现从随机搜索转变为可编程的循证工程学科。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Orchestra，一个“人在回路”的多智能体平台，它整合了生物学、化学和药理学，形成了一个自主的发现引擎。该系统通过一个编排者协调三个专业智能体，利用超过1000万条关联的知识图谱来选择靶点，进行药物设计/老药新用，并通过PBPK模拟进行严格评估，从而实现了药物发现过程的自动化和工程化。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 药物发现, 知识驱动, 治疗设计, PBPK模拟
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于构建了一个由多个专业智能体（生物学家、化学家、药理学家）组成的、由“编排者”驱动的系统（OrchestRA），实现了从知识图谱驱动的靶点选择到从头设计/老药新用，再到PBPK模拟验证的端到端自动化流程，并将人类置于循环中进行引导，从而将药物发现转化为可编程的工程过程。其重要性在于解决了计算设计与生理验证之间的鸿沟。局限性可能在于对知识图谱的依赖程度和实际的生理验证效果。

title: Rethinking Sample Polarity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) are typically trained using reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) to enhance their reasoning abilities. In this paradigm, policies are updated using both positive and negative self-generated rollouts, which correspond to distinct sample polarities. In this paper, we provide a systematic investigation into how these sample polarities affect RLVR training dynamics and behaviors. We find that positive samples sharpen existing correct reasoning patterns, while negative samples encourage exploration of new reasoning paths. We further explore how adjusting the advantage values of positive and negative samples at both the sample level and the token level affects RLVR training. Based on these insights, we propose an Adaptive and Asymmetric token-level Advantage shaping method for Policy Optimization, namely A3PO, that more precisely allocates advantage signals to key tokens across different polarities. Experiments across five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.title_translation: 关于带可验证奖励的强化学习中样本极性的再思考
AI.tldr: 研究发现RLVR中的正负样本对模型训练有不同的作用（正样本固化正确，负样本探索新路径），并基于此提出了一种名为A3PO的新方法，通过自适应调整Token级别的优势信号来优化策略，该方法在推理任务上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 在利用可验证奖励（RLVR）训练大型推理模型（LRMs）以增强其推理能力时，需要系统地研究策略更新中使用的正样本和负样本（对应不同样本极性）如何影响训练动态和行为。
AI.method: 系统调查了正负样本极性如何影响RLVR训练动态，并探索了调整样本级和Token级的正负样本优势值的影响，最终提出了自适应和非对称的Token级别优势整形方法（A3PO）。
AI.result: 研究发现，正样本可以使现有的正确推理模式更加清晰（sharpen），而负样本则鼓励探索新的推理路径。A3PO方法在五个推理基准上证明了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于对样本极性影响的见解，研究提出了A3PO方法，它能更精确地为不同极性的关键token分配优势信号，并在五个推理基准上证明了其有效性。
AI.translation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通常使用带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）进行训练，以增强其推理能力。在此范式中，策略使用自我生成的正面和负面滚出（rollouts）进行更新，这对应于不同的样本极性。在本文中，我们对这些样本极性如何影响RLVR的训练动态和行为进行了系统的研究。我们发现，正样本会使现有的正确推理模式更加清晰，而负样本则鼓励探索新的推理路径。我们进一步探讨了在样本级别和Token级别调整正负样本的优势值如何影响RLVR训练。基于这些见解，我们提出了一种用于策略优化的自适应和非对称Token级别优势整形方法，即A3PO，它可以更精确地为不同极性的关键Token分配优势信号。跨越五个推理基准的实验证明了我们方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究系统地探讨了在强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）框架中，正负样本极性对训练动态的影响。研究发现正样本强化现有正确推理，负样本促进新推理探索。基于此，研究提出了自适应和非对称的Token级别优势整形方法（A3PO），以更精确地分配优势信号，并在推理基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 可验证奖励, 样本极性, 优势整形, Token级别优化
AI.comments: 该研究系统地分析了RLVR中正负样本极性对训练动态的影响，并提出了A3PO方法，通过自适应和非对称地调整token级别的优势信号来优化策略，这在利用可验证奖励训练LRM方面具有创新性和重要性。方法的有效性通过五个推理基准得到验证，但其对更广泛的RL应用（非LRM）的泛化能力未在摘要中提及。

title: Multiple-play Stochastic Bandits with Prioritized Arm Capacity Sharing
summary: This paper proposes a variant of multiple-play stochastic bandits tailored to resource allocation problems arising from LLM applications, edge intelligence, etc. The model is composed of $M$ arms and $K$ plays. Each arm has a stochastic number of capacities, and each unit of capacity is associated with a reward function. Each play is associated with a priority weight. When multiple plays compete for the arm capacity, the arm capacity is allocated in a larger priority weight first manner. Instance independent and instance dependent regret lower bounds of $Ω( α_1 σ\sqrt{KM T} )$ and $Ω(α_1 σ^2 \frac{M}Δ \ln T)$ are proved, where $α_1$ is the largest priority weight and $σ$ characterizes the reward tail. When model parameters are given, we design an algorithm named \texttt{MSB-PRS-OffOpt} to locate the optimal play allocation policy with a computational complexity of $O(MK^3)$. Utilizing \texttt{MSB-PRS-OffOpt} as a subroutine, an approximate upper confidence bound (UCB) based algorithm is designed, which has instance independent and instance dependent regret upper bounds matching the corresponding lower bound up to factors of $ \sqrt{K \ln KT }$ and $α_1 K^2$ respectively. To this end, we address nontrivial technical challenges arising from optimizing and learning under a special nonlinear combinatorial utility function induced by the prioritized resource sharing mechanism.

AI.title_translation: 带有优先级臂容量共享的多臂随机赌博机
AI.tldr: 针对资源分配问题，本文将多臂赌博机模型扩展为带有优先容量共享的变体，证明了遗憾下界，设计了最优策略查找算法，并提出了一个性能良好的近似UCB学习算法，克服了非线性优化难题。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在解决源于大型语言模型（LLM）应用、边缘智能等的资源分配问题，为此提出了一个多臂随机赌博机模型的变体，该变体具有臂容量共享和播放优先级机制。
AI.method: 首先，证明了实例独立和实例依赖的遗憾下界为$Ω( α_1 σ\sqrt{KM T} )$和$Ω(α_1 σ^2 \frac{M}Δ \ln T)$。其次，设计了一个名为\texttt{MSB-PRS-OffOpt}的算法来定位最优播放分配策略，计算复杂度为$O(MK^3)$。最后，利用\texttt{MSB-PRS-OffOpt}作为子程序，设计了一个基于近似上置信界（UCB）的算法。
AI.result: 证明了实例独立和实例依赖的遗憾下界分别为$Ω( α_1 σ\sqrt{KM T} )$和$Ω(α_1 σ^2 \frac{M}Δ \ln T)$。算法\texttt{MSB-PRS-OffOpt}的计算复杂度为$O(MK^3)$。所提的UCB算法的实例独立和实例依赖的遗憾上界分别匹配下界（在$\sqrt{K \ln KT}$和$α_1 K^2$因子内）。
AI.conclusion: 研究设计了算法\texttt{MSB-PRS-OffOpt}来确定最优的播放分配策略，并基于此设计了一个近似上置信界（UCB）算法，该算法的实例独立和实例依赖的遗憾上界与相应的下界匹配（在特定因子内）。研究克服了由优先级资源共享机制引起的非线性组合效用函数的优化和学习中的技术挑战。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种适用于源于LLM应用、边缘智能等的资源分配问题的多臂随机赌博机变体。该模型由$M$个臂和$K$次播放组成。每个臂具有随机容量，每个容量单位关联一个奖励函数。每次播放关联一个优先级权重。当多个播放竞争臂容量时，容量按优先级权重高的优先分配。证明了实例无关和实例相关的遗憾下界分别为$Ω( α_1 σ\sqrt{KM T} )$和$Ω(α_1 σ^2 \frac{M}Δ \ln T)$，其中$α_1$是最大优先级权重，$\sigma$表征奖励尾部。当给定模型参数时，我们设计了一个名为\texttt{MSB-PRS-OffOpt}的算法来定位最优播放分配策略，其计算复杂度为$O(MK^3)$。利用\texttt{MSB-PRS-OffOpt}作为子程序，设计了一个近似上置信界（UCB）算法，该算法的实例无关和实例相关的遗憾上界分别匹配相应下界（在$\sqrt{K \ln KT}$和$α_1 K^2$因子内）。为此，我们解决了由优先级资源共享机制引起的特殊非线性组合效用函数的优化和学习中出现的非平凡技术挑战。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM应用和边缘智能中的资源分配问题，提出了一种具有优先臂容量共享机制的多臂随机赌博机模型。研究人员推导了该模型的遗憾下界，并设计了最优播放分配算法\texttt{MSB-PRS-OffOpt}。在此基础上，开发了一个近似UCB算法，其遗憾上界与下界渐近匹配，成功解决了优先级资源共享带来的非线性组合效用函数的优化挑战。
AI.keywords: 多臂随机赌博机, 优先级容量共享, 资源分配, 遗憾界, 播放分配
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于引入了带优先级的容量共享机制到多臂随机赌博机模型中，这使其能有效应用于资源受限的实际场景（如LLM应用）。证明的遗憾下界和上界在一定程度上是匹配的，表明所提算法具有较好的渐近性能。然而，其上界中仍然存在与$K$相关的较大因子，这可能是一个改进空间。

title: AstraNav-Memory: Contexts Compression for Long Memory
summary: Lifelong embodied navigation requires agents to accumulate, retain, and exploit spatial-semantic experience across tasks, enabling efficient exploration in novel environments and rapid goal reaching in familiar ones. While object-centric memory is interpretable, it depends on detection and reconstruction pipelines that limit robustness and scalability. We propose an image-centric memory framework that achieves long-term implicit memory via an efficient visual context compression module end-to-end coupled with a Qwen2.5-VL-based navigation policy. Built atop a ViT backbone with frozen DINOv3 features and lightweight PixelUnshuffle+Conv blocks, our visual tokenizer supports configurable compression rates; for example, under a representative 16$\times$ compression setting, each image is encoded with about 30 tokens, expanding the effective context capacity from tens to hundreds of images. Experimental results on GOAT-Bench and HM3D-OVON show that our method achieves state-of-the-art navigation performance, improving exploration in unfamiliar environments and shortening paths in familiar ones. Ablation studies further reveal that moderate compression provides the best balance between efficiency and accuracy. These findings position compressed image-centric memory as a practical and scalable interface for lifelong embodied agents, enabling them to reason over long visual histories and navigate with human-like efficiency.

AI.title_translation: AstraNav-Memory：用于长期记忆的上下文压缩
AI.tldr: AstraNav-Memory提出了一种压缩图像上下文的方法，用于具身智能体的长期隐式记忆，显著提高了导航性能和上下文容量，同时保持了效率。
AI.motivation: 终身具身导航需要智能体跨任务积累、保留和利用空间语义经验，以实现在新环境中的高效探索和在熟悉环境中的快速目标到达。现有的基于对象中心内存依赖于限制鲁棒性和可扩展性的检测和重建流程。
AI.method: 提出一个以图像为中心的记忆框架，通过一个高效的视觉上下文压缩模块，该模块与基于Qwen2.5-VL的导航策略端到端耦合。该视觉分词器基于具有冻结的DINOv3特征和轻量级PixelUnshuffle+Conv块的ViT骨干网构建，支持可配置的压缩率。
AI.result: 在GOAT-Bench和HM3D-OVON上实现了最先进的导航性能，提高了在不熟悉环境中的探索能力，并缩短了在熟悉环境中的路径。消融研究表明，适度的压缩在效率和准确性之间取得了最佳平衡。
AI.conclusion: 压缩的以图像为中心的记忆被定位为终身具身智能体的实用且可扩展的接口，使其能够对长的视觉历史进行推理并以类似人类的效率进行导航。
AI.translation: 终身具身导航要求智能体跨任务积累、保留和利用空间语义经验，从而能够在新的环境中实现高效探索，并在熟悉的环境中快速到达目标。尽管以对象为中心的记忆是可解释的，但它依赖于限制鲁棒性和可扩展性的检测和重建流程。我们提出了一个以图像为中心的记忆框架，通过一个高效的视觉上下文压缩模块，该模块与基于Qwen2.5-VL的导航策略端到端耦合，实现了长期的隐式记忆。我们的视觉分词器建立在具有冻结的DINOv3特征和轻量级PixelUnshuffle+Conv块的ViT骨干网上，支持可配置的压缩率；例如，在代表性的16倍压缩设置下，每张图像仅编码约30个tokens，将有效上下文容量从几十张图像扩展到几百张图像。在GOAT-Bench和HM3D-OVON上的实验结果表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的导航性能，提高了在不熟悉环境中的探索能力，并缩短了在熟悉环境中的路径。消融研究进一步揭示，适度的压缩在效率和准确性之间提供了最佳平衡。这些发现将压缩的以图像为中心的记忆定位为终身具身智能体的实用且可扩展的接口，使其能够对长的视觉历史进行推理并以类似人类的效率进行导航。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为AstraNav-Memory的以图像为中心的记忆框架，用于终身具身导航。它使用一个高效的视觉上下文压缩模块（基于ViT和DINOv3特征）与Qwen2.5-VL导航策略耦合，以实现长期的隐式记忆。该方法能将每张图像编码为少量tokens，极大地扩展了上下文容量，并在基准测试中展示了最先进的导航性能。
AI.keywords: 具身导航, 长期记忆, 视觉上下文压缩, 图像中心记忆, Qwen2.5-VL
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地提出了一个端到端耦合的视觉上下文压缩模块，用于实现长期的隐式记忆，解决了传统基于对象内存的鲁棒性和可扩展性限制。其重要性在于提供了一种实用且可扩展的接口，使具身智能体能够处理长期的视觉历史并实现类似人类的导航效率。局限性在于其性能依赖于所选的压缩率，需要权衡效率和准确性。

title: MAD-NG: Meta-Auto-Decoder Neural Galerkin Method for Solving Parametric Partial Differential Equations
summary: Parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) are fundamental for modeling a wide range of physical and engineering systems influenced by uncertain or varying parameters. Traditional neural network-based solvers, such as Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) and Deep Galerkin Methods, often face challenges in generalization and long-time prediction efficiency due to their dependence on full space-time approximations. To address these issues, we propose a novel and scalable framework that significantly enhances the Neural Galerkin Method (NGM) by incorporating the Meta-Auto-Decoder (MAD) paradigm. Our approach leverages space-time decoupling to enable more stable and efficient time integration, while meta-learning-driven adaptation allows rapid generalization to unseen parameter configurations with minimal retraining. Furthermore, randomized sparse updates effectively reduce computational costs without compromising accuracy. Together, these advancements enable our method to achieve physically consistent, long-horizon predictions for complex parameterized evolution equations with significantly lower computational overhead. Numerical experiments on benchmark problems demonstrate that our methods performs comparatively well in terms of accuracy, robustness, and adaptability.

AI.title_translation: MAD-NG：用于求解参数化偏微分方程的元自解码神经伽辽金方法
AI.tldr: MAD-NG通过结合MAD范式改进了神经伽辽金方法，利用空间-时间解耦和元学习实现了参数化PDEs的快速、稳定、低成本的长期预测，效果优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于神经网络的求解器（如PINNs和DGM）在泛化和长期预测效率方面存在挑战，因为它们依赖于全空间-时间近似。需要一种新的、可扩展的框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合Meta-Auto-Decoder（MAD）范式的增强型神经伽辽金方法（MAD-NG）。该方法利用空间-时间解耦实现更稳定高效的时间积分，利用元学习驱动的自适应能力快速泛化到未见参数配置，并通过随机稀疏更新降低计算成本。
AI.result: MAD-NG方法实现了物理一致的、具有显著降低的计算开销的复杂参数化演化方程的长期预测。数值实验表明，该方法在精度、鲁棒性和适应性方面表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法在精度、鲁棒性和适应性方面表现良好，能够以显著降低的计算开销实现复杂参数化演化方程的物理一致的长期预测。
AI.translation: 参数化偏微分方程（PDEs）是模拟受不确定或变化参数影响的各种物理和工程系统的基础。传统的基于神经网络的求解器，如物理信息神经网络（PINNs）和深度伽辽金方法，由于依赖于全空间-时间近似，在泛化和长期预测效率方面常常面临挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖且可扩展的框架，通过整合元自解码（MAD）范式，显著增强了神经伽辽金方法（NGM）。我们的方法利用空间-时间解耦以实现更稳定高效的时间积分，而元学习驱动的自适应能力则允许以最少的再训练快速泛化到未见的参数配置。此外，随机稀疏更新有效地降低了计算成本，同时不影响精度。这些进步共同使我们的方法能够以显著降低的计算开销，实现复杂参数化演化方程的物理一致的长期预测。基准问题的数值实验表明，我们的方法在精度、鲁棒性和适应性方面表现良好。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖且可扩展的MAD-NG框架，用于求解参数化偏微分方程（PDEs）。该方法通过引入Meta-Auto-Decoder（MAD）范式增强了神经伽辽金方法（NGM），实现了空间-时间解耦、元学习自适应和随机稀疏更新，从而提高了长期预测效率和对未见参数的泛化能力，同时显著降低了计算成本。
AI.keywords: 参数化偏微分方程, 神经伽辽金方法, 元学习, 空间-时间解耦, MAD-NG
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地结合了Meta-Auto-Decoder（MAD）范式来增强神经伽辽金方法（NGM），解决了传统PINNs和DGM在泛化和长期预测效率上的问题。通过空间-时间解耦和元学习驱动的自适应，该方法在保持精度的同时显著降低了计算开销，对于参数化PDEs的求解具有重要意义。其局限性可能在于元学习的训练复杂性和稀疏更新的参数选择。

title: Heaven-Sent or Hell-Bent? Benchmarking the Intelligence and Defectiveness of LLM Hallucinations
comments: Published as a conference paper at KDD 2026
summary: Hallucinations in large language models (LLMs) are commonly regarded as errors to be minimized. However, recent perspectives suggest that some hallucinations may encode creative or epistemically valuable content, a dimension that remains underquantified in current literature. Existing hallucination detection methods primarily focus on factual consistency, struggling to handle heterogeneous scientific tasks and balance creativity with accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose HIC-Bench, a novel evaluation framework that categorizes hallucinations into Intelligent Hallucinations (IH) and Defective Hallucinations (DH), enabling systematic investigation of their interplay in LLM creativity. HIC-Bench features three core characteristics: (1) Structured IH/DH Assessment. using a multi-dimensional metric matrix integrating Torrance Tests of Creative Thinking (TTCT) metrics (Originality, Feasibility, Value) with hallucination-specific dimensions (scientific plausibility, factual deviation); (2) Cross-Domain Applicability. spanning ten scientific domains with open-ended innovation tasks; and (3) Dynamic Prompt Optimization. leveraging the Dynamic Hallucination Prompt (DHP) to guide models toward creative and reliable outputs. The evaluation process employs multiple LLM judges, averaging scores to mitigate bias, with human annotators verifying IH/DH classifications. Experimental results reveal a nonlinear relationship between IH and DH, demonstrating that creativity and correctness can be jointly optimized. These insights position IH as a catalyst for creativity and reveal the ability of LLM hallucinations to drive scientific innovation.Additionally, the HIC-Bench offers a valuable platform for advancing research into the creative intelligence of LLM hallucinations.

AI.title_translation: 天赐还是魔鬼所致？基准测试LLM幻觉的智能性与缺陷性
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了HIC-Bench来区分LLM的“智能幻觉”（IH）和“缺陷幻觉”（DH），而不是将所有幻觉都视为错误。该框架评估了创造力（如原创性）和准确性。结果表明，IH可以作为创造力的催化剂，并且模型可以同时优化创造性和正确性。
AI.motivation: LLM的幻觉通常被视为需要最小化的错误。然而，最近的观点认为某些幻觉可能包含创造性或具有认识论价值的内容，而现有文献对这一维度量化不足。现有的幻觉检测方法主要关注事实一致性，难以处理异构的科学任务，也难以平衡创造性与准确性。
AI.method: 提出HIC-Bench，一个新颖的评估框架，将幻觉分为智能幻觉（IH）和缺陷幻觉（DH）。该框架具有三个核心特征：（1）结构化IH/DH评估，使用整合了TTCT指标（原创性、可行性、价值）和幻觉特定维度（科学合理性、事实偏差）的多维指标矩阵；（2）跨领域适用性，涵盖十个具有开放式创新任务的科学领域；（3）动态提示优化，利用动态幻觉提示（DHP）引导模型产生创造性和可靠的输出。评估过程使用多个LLM裁判并取平均分以减轻偏差，并由人工标注员验证IH/DH分类。
AI.result: 实验结果揭示了IH和DH之间的非线性关系，证明了创造性和正确性可以被联合优化。研究结果表明，智能幻觉可以作为创造力的催化剂，并揭示了LLM幻觉推动科学创新的能力。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，智能幻觉（IH）和缺陷幻觉（DH）之间存在非线性关系，证明了创造力和正确性可以协同优化。这些发现将IH定位为创造力的催化剂，并揭示了LLM幻觉推动科学创新的潜力。HIC-Bench为研究LLM幻觉的创造性智能提供了有价值的平台。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）中的幻觉通常被视为需要最小化的错误。然而，最近的观点认为一些幻觉可能包含创造性或具有认识论价值的内容，而现有文献对这一维度量化不足。现有的幻觉检测方法主要关注事实一致性，难以处理异构的科学任务并平衡创造性与准确性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了HIC-Bench，一个新颖的评估框架，它将幻觉分为智能幻觉（IH）和缺陷幻觉（DH），从而能够系统地研究它们在LLM创造力中的相互作用。HIC-Bench具有三个核心特征：（1）结构化IH/DH评估，使用整合了托伦斯创造性思维测试（TTCT）指标（原创性、可行性、价值）与幻觉特定维度（科学合理性、事实偏差）的多维指标矩阵；（2）跨领域适用性，涵盖十个具有开放式创新任务的科学领域；（3）动态提示优化，利用动态幻觉提示（DHP）引导模型产生创造性和可靠的输出。评估过程采用多个LLM裁判，取平均分以减轻偏差，并由人工标注员验证IH/DH分类。实验结果揭示了IH和DH之间的非线性关系，证明创造性和正确性可以被联合优化。这些见解将IH定位为创造力的催化剂，并揭示了LLM幻觉推动科学创新的能力。此外，HIC-Bench为推进对LLM幻觉创造性智能的研究提供了宝贵的平台。
AI.summary: 本文提出HIC-Bench评估框架，旨在系统研究大型语言模型（LLMs）中“智能幻觉”（IH）和“缺陷幻觉”（DH）的相互作用及其对创造力的影响。该框架通过结合创造力指标（如TTCT）和准确性维度，并在多个科学领域内进行开放式任务评估，超越了传统仅关注事实错误的方法。实验结果显示IH和DH存在非线性关系，证明创造力与正确性可以协同优化，并确立了IH作为科学创新的潜在驱动力。
AI.keywords: LLM幻觉, 智能幻觉, 缺陷幻觉, HIC-Bench, 创造力评估
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个区分“智能幻觉”（IH）和“缺陷幻觉”（DH）的评估框架HIC-Bench，这超越了传统上仅关注事实一致性的方法。它将创造力（基于TTCT指标）与准确性结合起来进行评估，对理解LLM的创造性潜力具有重要意义。一个潜在的局限是，尽管引入了人工标注员，但评估的客观性仍可能受到LLM裁判和多维度指标选择的影响。

title: Training-Free Disentangled Text-Guided Image Editing via Sparse Latent Constraints
summary: Text-driven image manipulation often suffers from attribute entanglement, where modifying a target attribute (e.g., adding bangs) unintentionally alters other semantic properties such as identity or appearance. The Predict, Prevent, and Evaluate (PPE) framework addresses this issue by leveraging pre-trained vision-language models for disentangled editing. In this work, we analyze the PPE framework, focusing on its architectural components, including BERT-based attribute prediction and StyleGAN2-based image generation on the CelebA-HQ dataset. Through empirical analysis, we identify a limitation in the original regularization strategy, where latent updates remain dense and prone to semantic leakage. To mitigate this issue, we introduce a sparsity-based constraint using L1 regularization on latent space manipulation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach enforces more focused and controlled edits, effectively reducing unintended changes in non-target attributes while preserving facial identity.

AI.title_translation: 通过稀疏隐空间约束实现的无训练解耦文本引导图像编辑
AI.tldr: 研究人员发现现有文本引导图像编辑（PPE框架）的隐空间更新过于“密集”并导致语义泄露。他们引入了L1正则化稀疏约束来限制隐空间操作，实验证明这能实现更精确、不影响身份的编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本驱动图像编辑方法（如PPE框架）在修改目标属性时，常出现属性之间纠缠的问题，导致身份或外观等其他语义属性被意外改变。
AI.method: 通过经验分析识别了原始PPE框架中潜在更新的密集性问题，并引入了一种基于L1正则化的稀疏性约束来限制隐空间操作。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，提出的稀疏性约束方法能够实现更聚焦和可控的编辑，有效减少了对非目标属性的意外更改，同时保留了面部身份。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的稀疏性约束通过L1正则化在隐空间操作中得到有效实施，实验结果表明该方法能够实现更聚焦、更可控的编辑，有效减少了对非目标属性的意外更改，同时保持了面部身份。
AI.translation: 文本驱动的图像操作通常受到属性纠缠的困扰，即修改一个目标属性（例如添加刘海）会无意中改变其他语义属性（如身份或外观）。可预测、预防和评估（PPE）框架通过利用预训练的视觉-语言模型来实现解耦编辑，解决了这个问题。在这项工作中，我们分析了PPE框架，重点关注其架构组成部分，包括基于BERT的属性预测和基于StyleGAN2在CelebA-HQ数据集上的图像生成。通过经验分析，我们发现原始正则化策略存在一个局限性，即隐空间更新仍然是密集的，容易发生语义泄露。为减轻这个问题，我们引入了一种使用L1正则化对隐空间操作进行稀疏性约束。实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够强制执行更聚焦和可控的编辑，有效地减少了对非目标属性的意外更改，同时保持了面部身份。
AI.summary: 本文分析了现有的文本驱动图像编辑框架PPE，发现其在隐空间更新中存在密集更新和语义泄露的局限性。为解决此问题，作者提出了一种基于L1正则化的稀疏性约束方法，该方法能使编辑更加聚焦和可控，有效保留了面部身份。
AI.keywords: 文本引导图像编辑, 属性解耦, 稀疏性约束, 隐空间操作, PPE框架
AI.comments: 该工作对现有的PPE框架进行了深入分析，并针对其在隐空间更新中存在的“密集”和“语义泄露”问题，创新性地引入了基于L1正则化的稀疏性约束，有效提高了编辑的精确性和对身份的保持能力。这是对文本引导图像编辑中解耦性问题的一个重要改进。

title: Mechanical Strength Prediction of Steel-Polypropylene Fiber-based High-Performance Concrete Using Hybrid Machine Learning Algorithms
summary: This research develops and evaluates machine learning models to predict the mechanical properties of steel-polypropylene fiber-reinforced high-performance concrete (HPC). Three model families were investigated: Extra Trees with XGBoost (ET-XGB), Random Forest with LightGBM (RF-LGBM), and Transformer with XGBoost (Transformer-XGB). The target properties included compressive strength (CS), flexural strength (FS), and tensile strength (TS), based on an extensive dataset compiled from published experimental studies. Model training involved k-fold cross-validation, hyperparameter optimization, Shapley additive explanations (SHAP), and uncertainty analysis to ensure both robustness and interpretability. Among the tested approaches, the ET-XGB model achieved the highest overall accuracy, with testing R^2 values of 0.994 for CS, 0.944 for FS, and 0.978 for TS and exhibited lowest uncertainty for CS and TS (approximately 13-16% and 30.4%, respectively). The RF-LGBM model provided the most stable and reliable predictions for FS (R^2 0.977), yielding the lowest uncertainty for FS (approximately 5-33%). The Transformer-XGB model demonstrated strong predictive capability (R^2 0.978 for TS and 0.967 for FS) but consistently showed the highest uncertainty, indicating reduced generalization reliability. SHAP analysis further indicated that fiber aspect ratios (AR1 and AR2), silica fume (Sfu), and steel fiber content (SF) were the most influential predictors of strength, whereas water content (W) and the water-binder ratio (w/b) consistently had negative effects. The findings confirm that machine learning models can provide accurate, interpretable, and generalizable predictions of HPC mechanical properties. These models offer valuable tools for optimizing concrete mix design and enhancing structural performance evaluation in engineering applications.

AI.title_translation: 钢聚丙烯纤维高性能混凝土的机械强度预测
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用三种混合机器学习模型（ET-XGB、RF-LGBM、Transformer-XGB）来预测钢聚丙烯纤维增强混凝土的抗压、抗折和抗拉强度。ET-XGB 模型在抗压和抗拉强度方面表现最佳，RF-LGBM 在抗折强度方面表现最佳。SHAP 分析表明，纤维长径比、硅灰和钢纤维含量是影响强度的关键因素，而水含量和水胶比则有负面影响。研究表明，机器学习模型可以准确、可解释且可泛化地预测混凝土性能，为优化混凝土配合比和评估结构性能提供工具。
AI.motivation: 开发和评估机器学习模型，以预测钢纤维-聚丙烯纤维增强高性能混凝土（HPC）的机械性能，为优化混凝土配合比和评估结构性能提供工具。
AI.method: 研究人员测试了三种混合机器学习模型：Extra Trees with XGBoost (ET-XGB)、Random Forest with LightGBM (RF-LGBM) 和 Transformer with XGBoost (Transformer-XGB)。模型训练包括 k 折交叉验证、超参数优化、Shapley 加法解释 (SHAP) 和不确定性分析。
AI.result: ET-XGB 模型在抗压强度 (R^2=0.994)、抗折强度 (R^2=0.944) 和抗拉强度 (R^2=0.978) 方面表现出最高的总体准确性，并且在抗压和抗拉强度方面显示出最低的不确定性。RF-LGBM 模型在抗折强度方面提供了最稳定和可靠的预测 (R^2=0.977)，不确定性最低。Transformer-XGB 模型显示出很强的预测能力，但其不确定性最高。SHAP 分析表明，纤维长径比、硅灰和钢纤维含量是影响强度的最重要因素，而水含量和水胶比则产生负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习模型能够准确、可解释且可泛化地预测高性能混凝土的机械性能，为优化混凝土配合比和评估结构性能提供了有价值的工具。
AI.translation: 本研究开发并评估了机器学习模型，用于预测钢纤维-聚丙烯纤维增强高性能混凝土（HPC）的力学性能。研究了三种模型系列：Extra Trees with XGBoost (ET-XGB)、Random Forest with LightGBM (RF-LGBM) 和 Transformer with XGBoost (Transformer-XGB)。目标性能包括抗压强度 (CS)、抗折强度 (FS) 和抗拉强度 (TS)，基于从已发表的实验研究中汇编的大型数据集。模型训练涉及 k 折交叉验证、超参数优化、Shapley 加法解释 (SHAP) 和不确定性分析，以确保鲁棒性和可解释性。在测试的方法中，ET-XGB 模型实现了最高的总体准确性，测试 R^2 值分别为 CS 0.994，FS 0.944，TS 0.978，并且对 CS 和 TS 的不确定性最低（分别约为 13-16% 和 30.4%）。RF-LGBM 模型为 FS 提供了最稳定和可靠的预测（R^2 0.977），不确定性最低（大约 5-33%）。Transformer-XGB 模型显示出强大的预测能力（TS 为 R^2 0.978，FS 为 0.967），但不确定性始终最高，表明泛化可靠性降低。SHAP 分析进一步表明，纤维长径比（AR1 和 AR2）、硅灰（Sfu）和钢纤维含量（SF）是强度最有影响的预测因子，而水含量（W）和水-粘合剂比（w/b）则持续产生负面影响。研究结果证实，机器学习模型能够提供准确、可解释且可泛化的 HPC 机械性能预测。这些模型为优化混凝土配合比和增强工程应用中的结构性能评估提供了有价值的工具。
AI.summary: 本研究利用三种混合机器学习模型（ET-XGB、RF-LGBM、Transformer-XGB）来预测钢纤维-聚丙烯纤维增强高性能混凝土的抗压、抗折和抗拉强度。ET-XGB 模型在抗压和抗拉强度预测方面表现最佳，RF-LGBM 在抗折强度预测方面表现最佳。SHAP 分析揭示了纤维长径比、硅灰和钢纤维含量对强度的显著影响。研究强调了机器学习在混凝土性能预测和优化设计中的潜力。
AI.keywords: 机器学习, 高性能混凝土, 钢纤维, 聚丙烯纤维, 力学性能预测
AI.comments: 该研究有效地结合了多种机器学习算法来解决混凝土力学性能预测问题，并利用 SHAP 值提供了模型的可解释性，这在工程应用中非常重要。然而，数据集的大小和多样性可能会影响模型的泛化能力，未来的研究可以关注更大规模和更多样化的数据集。

title: TrackTeller: Temporal Multimodal 3D Grounding for Behavior-Dependent Object References
summary: Understanding natural-language references to objects in dynamic 3D driving scenes is essential for interactive autonomous systems. In practice, many referring expressions describe targets through recent motion or short-term interactions, which cannot be resolved from static appearance or geometry alone. We study temporal language-based 3D grounding, where the objective is to identify the referred object in the current frame by leveraging multi-frame observations. We propose TrackTeller, a temporal multimodal grounding framework that integrates LiDAR-image fusion, language-conditioned decoding, and temporal reasoning in a unified architecture. TrackTeller constructs a shared UniScene representation aligned with textual semantics, generates language-aware 3D proposals, and refines grounding decisions using motion history and short-term dynamics. Experiments on the NuPrompt benchmark demonstrate that TrackTeller consistently improves language-grounded tracking performance, outperforming strong baselines with a 70% relative improvement in Average Multi-Object Tracking Accuracy and a 3.15-3.4 times reduction in False Alarm Frequency.

AI.title_translation: TrackTeller：面向行为依赖对象引用的时间多模态3D接地
AI.tldr: TrackTeller是一个新的框架，用于解决自动驾驶中基于动态行为的3D物体指代问题，它结合了视觉、激光雷达和语言信息，并通过时间推理来提高识别准确性，实验结果显示性能大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 在动态3D驾驶场景中理解指代自然语言对象对于交互式自主系统至关重要，因为许多指代表达式通过最近的运动或短期交互来描述目标，仅凭静态外观或几何信息无法解析。
AI.method: TrackTeller是一个时间多模态接地框架，它集成了激光雷达-图像融合、语言条件解码和时间推理在一个统一的架构中。它构建了一个与文本语义对齐的共享UniScene表示，生成了语言感知的3D提议，并利用运动历史和短期动态来精炼接地决策。
AI.result: TrackTeller在平均多目标跟踪精度（AMOTA）上实现了70%的相对提升，并将误报频率降低了3.15至3.4倍。
AI.conclusion: TrackTeller在NuPrompt基准测试中一致地提高了语言基础跟踪性能。
AI.translation: 理解动态3D驾驶场景中对物体的自然语言引用对于交互式自主系统至关重要。在实践中，许多指代表达式通过最近的运动或短期交互来描述目标，这无法仅从静态外观或几何形状中解析。我们研究时间语言基础的3D接地，其目标是通过利用多帧观测来识别当前帧中被指代的物体。我们提出了TrackTeller，一个时间多模态接地框架，它在一个统一的架构中集成了激光雷达-图像融合、语言条件解码和时间推理。TrackTeller构建了一个与文本语义对齐的共享UniScene表示，生成了语言感知的3D提议，并利用运动历史和短期动态来精炼接地决策。在NuPrompt基准上的实验表明，TrackTeller一致地提高了语言基础跟踪性能，在平均多目标跟踪精度（AMOTA）上相对提升了70%，并将误报频率降低了3.15-3.4倍，优于强大的基线。
AI.summary: TrackTeller是一个针对动态3D驾驶场景中行为依赖对象指代问题的时间多模态接地框架。它通过融合多帧观测、集成激光雷达-图像、语言解码和时间推理，构建统一的场景表示，并利用运动历史来精确识别当前帧中通过动态描述指代的对象，实验证明其性能显著优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 时间多模态接地, 3D物体指代, 行为依赖, 运动历史, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: TrackTeller的创新点在于其统一的架构，它将多模态融合、语言条件解码和时间推理结合起来，以解决依赖动态行为的3D物体指代问题。其重要性在于提升了自动驾驶系统中与动态场景交互的能力。局限性在于其性能评估仅基于NuPrompt基准。

title: Omni-Weather: Unified Multimodal Foundation Model for Weather Generation and Understanding
summary: Weather modeling requires both accurate prediction and mechanistic interpretation, yet existing methods treat these goals in isolation, separating generation from understanding. To address this gap, we present Omni-Weather, the first multimodal foundation model that unifies weather generation and understanding within a single architecture. Omni-Weather integrates a radar encoder for weather generation tasks, followed by unified processing using a shared self-attention mechanism. Moreover, we construct a Chain-of-Thought dataset for causal reasoning in weather generation, enabling interpretable outputs and improved perceptual quality. Extensive experiments show Omni-Weather achieves state-of-the-art performance in both weather generation and understanding. Our findings further indicate that generative and understanding tasks in the weather domain can mutually enhance each other. Omni-Weather also demonstrates the feasibility and value of unifying weather generation and understanding.

AI.title_translation: 全能天气：统一的天气生成与理解多模态基础模型
AI.tldr: Omni-Weather是一个统一的天气生成和理解的多模态基础模型，它使用雷达编码器和共享注意力机制，并通过思维链数据集提高了可解释性，在所有任务上都取得了最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将天气预测（生成）和机制解释（理解）视为孤立的目标，未能在一个统一的框架内解决这两个问题。
AI.method: Omni-Weather集成了雷达编码器用于天气生成任务，随后使用共享的自注意力机制进行统一处理。此外，构建了一个用于天气生成中因果推理的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）数据集。
AI.result: Omni-Weather在天气生成和理解任务中均实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，天气领域的生成和理解任务可以相互增强，并证明了统一天气生成和理解的可行性和价值。
AI.translation: 天气建模需要准确的预测和机制解释，但现有方法将这些目标视为孤立的，将生成与理解区分开来。为解决这一差距，我们提出了Omni-Weather，第一个在单一架构内统一天气生成和理解的多模态基础模型。Omni-Weather集成了用于天气生成任务的雷达编码器，随后通过共享的自注意力机制进行统一处理。此外，我们构建了一个用于天气生成中因果推理的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）数据集，以实现可解释的输出和提高感知质量。广泛的实验表明，Omni-Weather在天气生成和理解方面均取得了最先进的性能。我们的研究结果进一步表明，天气领域的生成和理解任务可以相互增强。Omni-Weather还证明了统一天气生成和理解的可行性和价值。

title: EFX Allocations Exist on Triangle-Free Multi-Graphs
summary: We study the fair allocation of indivisible goods among agents, with a focus on limiting envy. A central open question in this area is the existence of EFX allocations-allocations in which any envy of any agent i towards any agent j vanishes upon the removal of any single good from j's bundle. Establishing the existence of such allocations has proven notoriously difficult in general, but progress has been made for restricted valuation classes. Christodoulou et al. [2023] proved existence for graphical valuations, where goods correspond to edges in a graph, agents to nodes, and each agent values only incident edges. The graph was required to be simple, i.e., for any pair of agents, there could be at most one good that both agents value. The problem remained open, however, for multi-graph valuations, where for a pair of agents several goods may have value to both. In this setting, Sgouritsa and Sotiriou [2025] established existence whenever the shortest cycle with non-parallel edges has length at least six, while Afshinmehr et al. [2025] proved existence when the graph contains no odd cycles. In this paper, we strengthen these results by proving that EFX allocations always exist in multi-graphs that contain no cycle of length three. Assuming monotone valuations, we further provide a pseudo-polynomial time algorithm for computing such an allocation, which runs in polynomial time when agents have cancelable valuations, a strict superclass of additive valuation functions. Accordingly, our results stand as one of the only cases where EFX allocations exist for an arbitrary number of agents.

title: Variance-Aware Prior-Based Tree Policies for Monte Carlo Tree Search
summary: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) has profoundly influenced reinforcement learning (RL) by integrating planning and learning in tasks requiring long-horizon reasoning, exemplified by the AlphaZero family of algorithms. Central to MCTS is the search strategy, governed by a tree policy based on an upper confidence bound (UCB) applied to trees (UCT). A key factor in the success of AlphaZero is the introduction of a prior term in the UCB1-based tree policy PUCT, which improves exploration efficiency and thus accelerates training. While many alternative UCBs with stronger theoretical guarantees than UCB1 exist, extending them to prior-based UCTs has been challenging, since PUCT was derived empirically rather than from first principles. Recent work retrospectively justified PUCT by framing MCTS as a regularized policy optimization (RPO) problem. Building on this perspective, we introduce Inverse-RPO, a general methodology that systematically derives prior-based UCTs from any prior-free UCB. Applying this method to the variance-aware UCB-V, we obtain two new prior-based tree policies that incorporate variance estimates into the search. Experiments indicate that these variance-aware prior-based UCTs outperform PUCT across multiple benchmarks without incurring additional computational cost. We also provide an extension of the mctx library supporting variance-aware UCTs, showing that the required code changes are minimal and intended to facilitate further research on principled prior-based UCTs. title: Ghostcrafting AI: Under the Rug of Platform Labor
summary: Platform laborers play an indispensable yet hidden role in building and sustaining AI systems. Drawing on an eight-month ethnography of Bangladesh's platform labor industry and inspired by Gray and Suri, we conceptualize Ghostcrafting AI to describe how workers materially enable AI while remaining invisible or erased from recognition. Workers pursue platform labor as a path to prestige and mobility but sustain themselves through resourceful, situated learning - renting cyber-cafe computers, copying gig templates, following tutorials in unfamiliar languages, and relying on peer networks. At the same time, they face exploitative wages, unreliable payments, biased algorithms, and governance structures that make their labor precarious and invisible. To cope, they develop tactical repertoires such as identity masking, bypassing platform fees, and pirated tools. These practices reveal both AI's dependency on ghostcrafted labor and the urgent need for design, policy, and governance interventions that ensure fairness, recognition, and sustainability in platform futures.

title: Causal-HM: Restoring Physical Generative Logic in Multimodal Anomaly Detection via Hierarchical Modulation
summary: Multimodal Unsupervised Anomaly Detection (UAD) is critical for quality assurance in smart manufacturing, particularly in complex processes like robotic welding. However, existing methods often suffer from causal blindness, treating process modalities (e.g., real-time video, audio, and sensors) and result modalities (e.g., post-weld images) as equal feature sources, thereby ignoring the inherent physical generative logic. Furthermore, the heterogeneity gap between high-dimensional visual data and low-dimensional sensor signals frequently leads to critical process context being drowned out. In this paper, we propose Causal-HM, a unified multimodal UAD framework that explicitly models the physical Process to Result dependency. Specifically, our framework incorporates two key innovations: a Sensor-Guided CHM Modulation mechanism that utilizes low-dimensional sensor signals as context to guide high-dimensional audio-visual feature extraction , and a Causal-Hierarchical Architecture that enforces a unidirectional generative mapping to identify anomalies that violate physical consistency. Extensive experiments on our newly constructed Weld-4M benchmark across four modalities demonstrate that Causal-HM achieves a state-of-the-art (SOTA) I-AUROC of 90.7%. Code will be released after the paper is accepted.

title: Rethinking Output Alignment For 1-bit Post-Training Quantization of Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) deliver strong performance across a wide range of NLP tasks, but their massive sizes hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices. To reduce their computational and memory burden, various compression techniques have been proposed, including quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation. Among these, post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely adopted for its efficiency, as it requires no retraining and only a small dataset for calibration, enabling low-cost deployment. Recent advances for post-training quantization have demonstrated that even sub-4-bit methods can maintain most of the original model performance. However, 1-bit quantization that converts floating-point weights to \(\pm\)1, remains particularly challenging, as existing 1-bit PTQ methods often suffer from significant performance degradation compared to the full-precision models. Specifically, most of existing 1-bit PTQ approaches focus on weight alignment, aligning the full-precision model weights with those of the quantized models, rather than directly aligning their outputs. Although the output-matching approach objective is more intuitive and aligns with the quantization goal, naively applying it in 1-bit LLMs often leads to notable performance degradation. In this paper, we investigate why and under what conditions output-matching fails, in the context of 1-bit LLM quantization. Based on our findings, we propose a novel data-aware PTQ approach for 1-bit LLMs that explicitly accounts for activation error accumulation while keeping optimization efficient. Empirical experiments demonstrate that our solution consistently outperforms existing 1-bit PTQ methods with minimal overhead.

title: Semantic Codebooks as Effective Priors for Neural Speech Compression
summary: Speech codecs are traditionally optimized for waveform fidelity, allocating bits to preserve acoustic detail even when much of it can be inferred from linguistic structure. This leads to inefficient compression and suboptimal performance on downstream recognition tasks. We propose SemDAC, a semantic-aware neural audio codec that leverages semantic codebooks as effective priors for speech compression. In SemDAC, the first quantizer in a residual vector quantization (RVQ) stack is distilled from HuBERT features to produce semantic tokens that capture phonetic content, while subsequent quantizers model residual acoustics. A FiLM-conditioned decoder reconstructs audio conditioned on the semantic tokens, improving efficiency in the use of acoustic codebooks. Despite its simplicity, this design proves highly effective: SemDAC outperforms DAC across perceptual metrics and achieves lower WER when running Whisper on reconstructed speech, all while operating at substantially lower bitrates (e.g., 0.95 kbps vs. 2.5 kbps for DAC). These results demonstrate that semantic codebooks provide an effective inductive bias for neural speech compression, producing compact yet recognition-friendly representations.

title: Structural Induced Exploration for Balanced and Scalable Multi-Robot Path Planning
summary: Multi-robot path planning is a fundamental yet challenging problem due to its combinatorial complexity and the need to balance global efficiency with fair task allocation among robots. Traditional swarm intelligence methods, although effective on small instances, often converge prematurely and struggle to scale to complex environments. In this work, we present a structure-induced exploration framework that integrates structural priors into the search process of the ant colony optimization (ACO). The approach leverages the spatial distribution of the task to induce a structural prior at initialization, thereby constraining the search space. The pheromone update rule is then designed to emphasize structurally meaningful connections and incorporates a load-aware objective to reconcile the total travel distance with individual robot workload. An explicit overlap suppression strategy further ensures that tasks remain distinct and balanced across the team. The proposed framework was validated on diverse benchmark scenarios covering a wide range of instance sizes and robot team configurations. The results demonstrate consistent improvements in route compactness, stability, and workload distribution compared to representative metaheuristic baselines. Beyond performance gains, the method also provides a scalable and interpretable framework that can be readily applied to logistics, surveillance, and search-and-rescue applications where reliable large-scale coordination is essential.

title: Regularity analysis and verification of Coons volume mappings
summary: The Coons volume provides a classical approach for constructing three-dimensional parametric mappings via boundary surface interpolation and is widely employed in volumetric mesh generation, computer-aided geometric design, and isogeometric analysis. However, due to curvature variations and continuity limitations of the boundary surfaces, the Jacobian determinant of a Coons volume may locally vanish or become negative, resulting in a non-regular mapping. This undermines mesh quality and compromises the stability of subsequent numerical computations. Ensuring the regularity of Coons volumes is therefore critical for robust parametric modeling. This paper develops a systematic framework for analyzing and verifying the regularity of Coons volumes. We first derive a general sufficient condition applicable to arbitrary boundary parameterizations, independent of specific analytical forms. For Bézier-form Coons volumes, we introduce a criterion based on the Bézier coefficients of the Jacobian determinant, transforming the verification problem into checking the positivity of control coefficients. Furthermore, we construct a necessary condition by applying a subdivision strategy combined with the Bézier blossoming technique, ensuring that regularity is preserved in all subdomains. By integrating these conditions, we design an efficient verification algorithm whose correctness and computational performance are validated through numerical experiments. We observe that the regularity of a Coons volume is closely related to the geometric similarity of its opposite boundary surfaces. Moreover, through Bézier extraction, the algorithm is extended to multi-patch B-spline volumes of arbitrary topology. Numerical tests show that the method completes regularity verification in milliseconds, enabling real-time application.

title: Near-Optimal Coalition Structures in Polynomial Time
summary: We study the classical coalition structure generation (CSG) problem and compare the anytime behavior of three algorithmic paradigms: dynamic programming (DP), MILP branch-and-bound, and sparse relaxations based on greedy or $l_1$-type methods. Under a simple random "sparse synergy" model for coalition values, we prove that sparse relaxations recover coalition structures whose welfare is arbitrarily close to optimal in polynomial time with high probability. In contrast, broad classes of DP and MILP algorithms require exponential time before attaining comparable solution quality. This establishes a rigorous probabilistic anytime separation in favor of sparse relaxations, even though exact methods remain ultimately optimal.

title: Near-Field Communication with Massive Movable Antennas: An Electrostatic Equilibrium Perspective
summary: Recent advancements in large-scale position-reconfigurable antennas have opened up new dimensions to effectively utilize the spatial degrees of freedom (DoFs) of wireless channels. However, the deployment of existing antenna placement schemes is primarily hindered by their limited scalability and frequently overlooked near-field effects in large-scale antenna systems. In this paper, we propose a novel antenna placement approach tailored for near-field massive multiple-input multiple-output systems, which effectively exploits the spatial DoFs to enhance spectral efficiency. For that purpose, we first reformulate the antenna placement problem in the angular domain, resulting in a weighted Fekete problem. We then derive the optimality condition and reveal that the {optimal} antenna placement is in principle an electrostatic equilibrium problem. To further reduce the computational complexity of numerical optimization, we propose an ordinary differential equation (ODE)-based framework to efficiently solve the equilibrium problem. In particular, the optimal antenna positions are characterized by the roots of the polynomial solutions to specific ODEs in the normalized angular domain. By simply adopting a two-step eigenvalue decomposition (EVD) approach, the optimal antenna positions can be efficiently obtained. Furthermore, we perform an asymptotic analysis when the antenna size tends to infinity, which yields a closed-form solution. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme efficiently harnesses the spatial DoFs of near-field channels with prominent gains in spectral efficiency and maintains robustness against system parameter mismatches. In addition, the derived asymptotic closed-form {solution} closely approaches the theoretical optimum across a wide range of practical scenarios.

title: Verifiable Passkey: The Decentralized Authentication Standard
summary: Passwordless authentication has revolutionized the way we authenticate across various websites and services. FIDO2 Passkeys, is one of the most-widely adopted standards of passwordless authentication that promises phishing-resistance. However, like any other authentication system, passkeys require the user details to be saved on a centralized server, also known as Relying Party (RP) Server. This has led users to create a new passkey for every new online account. While this just works for a limited number of online accounts, the limited storage space of secure storage modules like TPM or a physical security key limits the number of passkeys a user can have. For example, Yubico Yubikey 5 (firmware 5.0 - 5.6) offers to store only 25 passkeys, while firmware 5.7+ allows to store upto 100 [1]. To overcome this problem, one of the widely adopted approaches is to use Federated Authentication with Single Sign On (SSO). This allows the user to create a passkey for the Identity Provider (IdP) and use the IdP to authenticate to all service providers. This proves to be a significant privacy risk since the IdP can potentially track users across different services. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces a novel standard 'Verifiable Passkey' that allows the user to use Passkeys created for a Verifiable Credential issuer across any platform without risking privacy or user tracking.

title: The Deepfake Detective: Interpreting Neural Forensics Through Sparse Features and Manifolds
summary: Deepfake detection models have achieved high accuracy in identifying synthetic media, but their decision processes remain largely opaque. In this paper we present a mechanistic interpretability framework for deepfake detection applied to a vision-language model. Our approach combines a sparse autoencoder (SAE) analysis of internal network representations with a novel forensic manifold analysis that probes how the model's features respond to controlled forensic artifact manipulations. We demonstrate that only a small fraction of latent features are actively used in each layer, and that the geometric properties of the model's feature manifold, including intrinsic dimensionality, curvature, and feature selectivity, vary systematically with different types of deepfake artifacts. These insights provide a first step toward opening the "black box" of deepfake detectors, allowing us to identify which learned features correspond to specific forensic artifacts and to guide the development of more interpretable and robust models.

title: Fully Dynamic Spectral Sparsification for Directed Hypergraphs
summary:
There has been a surge of interest in spectral hypergraph sparsification, a natural generalization of spectral sparsification for graphs. In this paper, we present a simple fully dynamic algorithm for maintaining spectral hypergraph sparsifiers of \textit{directed} hypergraphs. Our algorithm achieves a near-optimal size of $O(n^2 / \varepsilon ^2 \log ^7 m)$ and amortized update time of $O(r^2 \log ^3 m)$, where $n$ is the number of vertices, and $m$ and $r$ respectively upper bound the number of hyperedges and the rank of the hypergraph at any time.
  We also extend our approach to the parallel batch-dynamic setting, where a batch of any $k$ hyperedge insertions or deletions can be processed with $O(kr^2 \log ^3 m)$ amortized work and $O(\log ^2 m)$ depth. This constitutes the first spectral-based sparsification algorithm in this setting.

title: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Models for Perception in Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Recently, a plethora of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms have been proposed to achieve the efficiency, safety, and reliability of autonomous vehicles (AVs). The AVs use a perception system to detect, localize, and identify other vehicles, pedestrians, and road signs to perform safe navigation and decision-making. In this paper, we compare the performance of DL models, including YOLO-NAS and YOLOv8, for a detection-based perception task. We capture a custom dataset and experiment with both DL models using our custom dataset. Our analysis reveals that the YOLOv8s model saves 75% of training time compared to the YOLO-NAS model. In addition, the YOLOv8s model (83%) outperforms the YOLO-NAS model (81%) when the target is to achieve the highest object detection accuracy. These comparative analyses of these new emerging DL models will allow the relevant research community to understand the models' performance under real-world use case scenarios.

title: UniPercept: Towards Unified Perceptual-Level Image Understanding across Aesthetics, Quality, Structure, and Texture
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual understanding tasks such as visual grounding, segmentation, and captioning. However, their ability to perceive perceptual-level image features remains limited. In this work, we present UniPercept-Bench, a unified framework for perceptual-level image understanding across three key domains: Aesthetics, Quality, Structure and Texture. We establish a hierarchical definition system and construct large-scale datasets to evaluate perceptual-level image understanding. Based on this foundation, we develop a strong baseline UniPercept trained via Domain-Adaptive Pre-Training and Task-Aligned RL, enabling robust generalization across both Visual Rating (VR) and Visual Question Answering (VQA) tasks. UniPercept outperforms existing MLLMs on perceptual-level image understanding and can serve as a plug-and-play reward model for text-to-image generation. This work defines Perceptual-Level Image Understanding in the era of MLLMs and, through the introduction of a comprehensive benchmark together with a strong baseline, provides a solid foundation for advancing perceptual-level multimodal image understanding.

title: Dictionary-Transform Generative Adversarial Networks
summary:
Generative adversarial networks (GANs) are widely used for distribution learning, yet their classical formulations remain theoretically fragile, with ill-posed objectives, unstable training dynamics, and limited interpretability. In this work, we introduce \emph{Dictionary-Transform Generative Adversarial Networks} (DT-GAN), a fully model-based adversarial framework in which the generator is a sparse synthesis dictionary and the discriminator is an analysis transform acting as an energy model. By restricting both players to linear operators with explicit constraints, DT-GAN departs fundamentally from neural GAN architectures and admits rigorous theoretical analysis.
  We show that the DT-GAN adversarial game is well posed and admits at least one Nash equilibrium. Under a sparse generative model, equilibrium solutions are provably identifiable up to standard permutation and sign ambiguities and exhibit a precise geometric alignment between synthesis and analysis operators. We further establish finite-sample stability and consistency of empirical equilibria, demonstrating that DT-GAN training converges reliably under standard sampling assumptions and remains robust in heavy-tailed regimes.
  Experiments on mixture-structured synthetic data validate the theoretical predictions, showing that DT-GAN consistently recovers underlying structure and exhibits stable behavior under identical optimization budgets where a standard GAN degrades. DT-GAN is not proposed as a universal replacement for neural GANs, but as a principled adversarial alternative for data distributions that admit sparse synthesis structure. The results demonstrate that adversarial learning can be made interpretable, stable, and provably correct when grounded in classical sparse modeling.

title: Some Patterns of Duplications in the outputs of Mersenne Twister Pseudorandom Number Generator MT19937
summary:
The Mersenne Twister MT19937 pseudorandom number generator, introduced by the last two authors in 1998, is still widely used. It passes all existing statistical tests, except for the linear complexity test, which measures the ratio of the even-odd of the number of 1's among specific bits (and hence should not be important for most applications). Harase reported that MT19937 is rejected by some birthday-spacing tests, which are rather artificially designed. In this paper, we report that MT19937 fails in a natural test based on the distribution of run-lengths on which we found an identical value in the output 32-bit integers. The number of observations of the run-length 623 is some 40 times larger than the expectation (and than the numbers of the observations of 622 and 624, etc.), which implies that the corresponding p-value is almost 0.
  We mathematically analyze the phenomena, and obtain a theorem which explains these failures. It seems not to be a serious defect of MT19937, because finding the defect requires astronomical efforts. Still, the phenomena should be reported to the academic society relating to pseudorandom number generation.

title: Exploring the Security Threats of Retriever Backdoors in Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation (RACG) is increasingly adopted to enhance Large Language Models for software development, yet its security implications remain dangerously underexplored. This paper conducts the first systematic exploration of a critical and stealthy threat: backdoor attacks targeting the retriever component, which represents a significant supply-chain vulnerability. It is infeasible to assess this threat realistically, as existing attack methods are either too ineffective to pose a real danger or are easily detected by state-of-the-art defense mechanisms spanning both latent-space analysis and token-level inspection, which achieve consistently high detection rates. To overcome this barrier and enable a realistic analysis, we first developed VenomRACG, a new class of potent and stealthy attack that serves as a vehicle for our investigation. Its design makes poisoned samples statistically indistinguishable from benign code, allowing the attack to consistently maintain low detectability across all evaluated defense mechanisms. Armed with this capability, our exploration reveals a severe vulnerability: by injecting vulnerable code equivalent to only 0.05% of the entire knowledge base size, an attacker can successfully manipulate the backdoored retriever to rank the vulnerable code in its top-5 results in 51.29% of cases. This translates to severe downstream harm, causing models like GPT-4o to generate vulnerable code in over 40% of targeted scenarios, while leaving the system's general performance intact. Our findings establish that retriever backdooring is not a theoretical concern but a practical threat to the software development ecosystem that current defenses are blind to, highlighting the urgent need for robust security measures.

title: Contrastive Graph Modeling for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
comments: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging (T-MI), 2026
summary: Cross-domain few-shot medical image segmentation (CD-FSMIS) offers a promising and data-efficient solution for medical applications where annotations are severely scarce and multimodal analysis is required. However, existing methods typically filter out domain-specific information to improve generalization, which inadvertently limits cross-domain performance and degrades source-domain accuracy. To address this, we present Contrastive Graph Modeling (C-Graph), a framework that leverages the structural consistency of medical images as a reliable domain-transferable prior. We represent image features as graphs, with pixels as nodes and semantic affinities as edges. A Structural Prior Graph (SPG) layer is proposed to capture and transfer target-category node dependencies and enable global structure modeling through explicit node interactions. Building upon SPG layers, we introduce a Subgraph Matching Decoding (SMD) mechanism that exploits semantic relations among nodes to guide prediction. Furthermore, we design a Confusion-minimizing Node Contrast (CNC) loss to mitigate node ambiguity and subgraph heterogeneity by contrastively enhancing node discriminability in the graph space. Our method significantly outperforms prior CD-FSMIS approaches across multiple cross-domain benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art performance while simultaneously preserving strong segmentation accuracy on the source domain.

title: SlideChain: Semantic Provenance for Lecture Understanding via Blockchain Registration
summary: Modern vision--language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to interpret and generate educational content, yet their semantic outputs remain challenging to verify, reproduce, and audit over time. Inconsistencies across model families, inference settings, and computing environments undermine the reliability of AI-generated instructional material, particularly in high-stakes and quantitative STEM domains. This work introduces SlideChain, a blockchain-backed provenance framework designed to provide verifiable integrity for multimodal semantic extraction at scale. Using the SlideChain Slides Dataset-a curated corpus of 1,117 medical imaging lecture slides from a university course-we extract concepts and relational triples from four state-of-the-art VLMs and construct structured provenance records for every slide. SlideChain anchors cryptographic hashes of these records on a local EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine)-compatible blockchain, providing tamper-evident auditability and persistent semantic baselines. Through the first systematic analysis of semantic disagreement, cross-model similarity, and lecture-level variability in multimodal educational content, we reveal pronounced cross-model discrepancies, including low concept overlap and near-zero agreement in relational triples on many slides. We further evaluate gas usage, throughput, and scalability under simulated deployment conditions, and demonstrate perfect tamper detection along with deterministic reproducibility across independent extraction runs. Together, these results show that SlideChain provides a practical and scalable step toward trustworthy, verifiable multimodal educational pipelines, supporting long-term auditability, reproducibility, and integrity for AI-assisted instructional systems.
