AI.title_translation: 从大规模自然驾驶数据中主动学习碰撞风险
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为GSSM的数据驱动方法，无需标注即可从自然驾驶数据中学习碰撞风险，并在真实碰撞和近乎碰撞场景中取得了显著的预测精度和提前量，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在预测碰撞风险时存在标注成本高、难以考虑上下文因素或场景受限等问题，因此需要一种更有效的方法来主动预警碰撞。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为通用代理安全度量（GSSM）的数据驱动方法，直接从自然驾驶数据中学习碰撞风险，无需碰撞或风险标签。该方法利用瞬时运动学信息，并可整合交互模式和上下文因素以提高性能。
AI.result: 在2,591个真实碰撞和近乎碰撞场景中，仅使用瞬时运动学信息的GSSM达到了0.9的精确率-召回率曲线下面积，并将潜在碰撞的预警时间提前了2.6秒。结合交互模式和上下文因素可进一步提升性能，且在各种交互场景下均优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: GSSM是一种可扩展、上下文感知且可泛化的方法，能够识别潜在的危险交互，为自动驾驶系统和交通事件管理提供主动安全支持。
AI.translation: 准确且主动地向驾驶员或自动驾驶系统预警新兴碰撞对于道路安全至关重要，尤其是在高度交互和复杂的城市环境中。现有方法要么需要对稀疏风险进行劳动密集型标注，要么难以考虑变化的上下文因素，要么针对有限的场景进行了定制。在此，我们提出了通用代理安全度量（GSSM），这是一种数据驱动的方法，可以在无需碰撞或风险标签的情况下从自然驾驶中学习碰撞风险。在多个数据集上训练并在2,591次真实世界碰撞和近乎碰撞中进行评估，仅使用瞬时运动学信息的GSSM达到了0.9的精确率-召回率曲线下面积，并将预防潜在碰撞的中值提前量提高到2.6秒。整合额外的交互模式和上下文因素可提供进一步的性能提升。在诸如追尾、合并和转弯等交互场景中，GSSM在准确性和及时性方面始终优于现有基线。这些结果确立了GSSM作为一种可扩展、上下文感知和可泛化的基础，用于在危险交互变得不可避免之前识别它们，从而支持自动驾驶系统和交通事件管理中的主动安全。代码和实验数据可在https://github.com/Yiru-Jiao/GSSM公开获取。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种名为GSSM的数据驱动方法，能够从大规模自然驾驶数据中学习碰撞风险，无需人工标注。该方法通过分析运动学信息、交互模式和上下文因素，能够提前预警潜在碰撞，并在真实场景中表现出优于现有方法的准确性和及时性，为自动驾驶和交通安全提供了新的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 碰撞风险预测,自然驾驶数据,GSSM,主动安全,自动驾驶
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的数据驱动方法（GSSM），解决了传统碰撞风险预测中存在的标注成本高和场景适应性差的问题。其利用大规模自然驾驶数据，无需显式风险标签即可学习碰撞风险，并在真实世界数据上取得了优异的预测性能和显著的提前预警时间。该方法的泛化能力和上下文感知能力是其重要亮点，为自动驾驶和交通安全领域提供了有价值的贡献。然而，未来可以进一步探索其在更广泛的交通场景和不同传感器数据下的鲁棒性和有效性。

title: Personalize Your Gaussian: Consistent 3D Scene Personalization from a Single Image
summary: Personalizing 3D scenes from a single reference image enables intuitive user-guided editing, which requires achieving both multi-view consistency across perspectives and referential consistency with the input image. However, these goals are particularly challenging due to the viewpoint bias caused by the limited perspective provided in a single image. Lacking the mechanisms to effectively expand reference information beyond the original view, existing methods of image-conditioned 3DGS personalization often suffer from this viewpoint bias and struggle to produce consistent results. Therefore, in this paper, we present Consistent Personalization for 3D Gaussian Splatting (CP-GS), a framework that progressively propagates the single-view reference appearance to novel perspectives. In particular, CP-GS integrates pre-trained image-to-3D generation and iterative LoRA fine-tuning to extract and extend the reference appearance, and finally produces faithful multi-view guidance images and the personalized 3DGS outputs through a view-consistent generation process guided by geometric cues. Extensive experiments on real-world scenes show that our CP-GS effectively mitigates the viewpoint bias, achieving high-quality personalization that significantly outperforms existing methods.

AI.title_translation: 个性化你的高斯：来自单张图像的连贯3D场景个性化
AI.tldr: 为了解决单张图片个性化3D高斯泼溅时出现的视角偏差问题，本文提出了CP-GS框架，它结合了图像到3D生成和LoRA微调，通过渐进式传播参考外观，成功生成了高质量且视角一致的个性化3D场景。
AI.motivation: 实现从单参考图像进行3D场景个性化，以支持直观的用户引导编辑，但现有方法因单视图的视角偏差而难以实现多视角一致性和参考一致性。
AI.method: CP-GS框架通过整合预训练的图生3D生成和迭代的LoRA微调来提取和扩展参考外观，最后通过由几何线索引导的视图一致性生成过程，生成忠实的、多视角的引导图像和个性化的3DGS输出。
AI.result: CP-GS有效地减轻了视角偏差，实现了显著优于现有方法的高质量个性化。
AI.conclusion: CP-GS有效减轻了视角偏差，实现了高质量的个性化，其性能显著优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 从单张参考图像对3D场景进行个性化处理，可以实现直观的用户引导编辑，这要求在不同视角之间实现多视角一致性，并与输入图像保持参考一致性。然而，由于单张图像提供的视角有限，这些目标尤其具有挑战性。现有的图像条件3DGS个性化方法由于缺乏有效机制将参考信息扩展到原始视图之外，通常会受到这种视角偏差的影响，并难以产生一致的结果。因此，在本文中，我们提出了用于3D高斯泼溅的一致性个性化（CP-GS），一个逐步将单视图参考外观传播到新视角的框架。具体来说，CP-GS集成了预训练的图像到3D生成和迭代的LoRA微调，以提取和扩展参考外观，最后通过由几何线索引导的视图一致性生成过程，产生忠实的、多视角的引导图像和个性化的3DGS输出。在真实世界场景上的广泛实验表明，我们的CP-GS有效地减轻了视角偏差，实现了显著优于现有方法的高质量个性化。
AI.summary: CP-GS是一个用于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的连贯个性化框架，旨在解决单图像个性化中常见的视角偏差问题。它通过结合预训练的图像到3D生成和迭代的LoRA微调，逐步将单视图参考外观传播到新的视角，确保了多视角的一致性和对输入图像的忠实度。
AI.keywords: 3D高斯泼溅, 场景个性化, 单视图, 视角偏差, 多视角一致性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种渐进式传播单视图参考外观到新视角的方法（CP-GS），有效解决了单视图个性化中固有的视角偏差问题。其重要性在于提升了基于图像的3DGS个性化的多视角一致性和保真度。局限性可能在于对预训练模型和迭代微调的依赖。

title: Advancing Expert Specialization for Better MoE
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling of large language models (LLMs) by activating only a subset of experts per input. However, we observe that the commonly used auxiliary load balancing loss often leads to expert overlap and overly uniform routing, which hinders expert specialization and degrades overall performance during post-training. To address this, we propose a simple yet effective solution that introduces two complementary objectives: (1) an orthogonality loss to encourage experts to process distinct types of tokens, and (2) a variance loss to encourage more discriminative routing decisions. Gradient-level analysis demonstrates that these objectives are compatible with the existing auxiliary loss and contribute to optimizing the training process. Experimental results over various model architectures and across multiple benchmarks show that our method significantly enhances expert specialization. Notably, our method improves classic MoE baselines with auxiliary loss by up to 23.79%, while also maintaining load balancing in downstream tasks, without any architectural modifications or additional components. We will release our code to contribute to the community.

AI.title_translation: 提升专家专业化以优化MoE
AI.tldr: 为解决MoE模型中负载均衡损失导致的专家重叠问题，作者引入了正交性和方差损失来增强专家特化，实验表明性能提升高达23.79%，且无需改变模型架构。
AI.motivation: 常见的辅助负载均衡损失会导致专家重叠和路由过于均匀，从而阻碍专家特化并降低模型在后训练阶段的整体性能。
AI.method: 提出了两个互补的目标：(1) 正交性损失，以鼓励专家处理不同类型的token；(2) 方差损失，以鼓励更具区分性的路由决策。这些目标与现有的辅助损失兼容。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法显著增强了专家特化，相对于带有辅助损失的经典MoE基线，性能提升高达23.79%，同时在下游任务中保持了负载均衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法显著增强了专家特化，在保持负载均衡的同时，相对于带有辅助损失的经典MoE基线，性能提升高达23.79%，且无需任何架构修改或额外组件。
AI.translation: 混合专家（MoE）模型通过为每个输入激活专家子集，实现了大型语言模型（LLMs）的有效扩展。然而，我们观察到常用的辅助负载均衡损失通常会导致专家重叠和过于均匀的路由，这阻碍了专家特化，并在后训练期间降低了整体性能。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种简单而有效的解决方案，引入了两个互补的目标：（1）一个正交性损失，以鼓励专家处理不同类型的token；和（2）一个方差损失，以鼓励更具区分性的路由决策。梯度级分析表明，这些目标与现有的辅助损失兼容，并有助于优化训练过程。在各种模型架构和多个基准测试上的实验结果表明，我们的方法显著增强了专家特化。值得注意的是，我们的方法在带有辅助损失的经典MoE基线上提升了高达23.79%，同时在下游任务中保持了负载均衡，而无需任何架构修改或额外组件。我们将发布我们的代码以回馈社区。
AI.summary: 本研究针对MoE模型中负载均衡损失导致的专家重叠问题，提出引入正交性损失和方差损失两个互补目标，以促进专家处理不同类型的token和实现更具区分性的路由。实验证明，该方法能显著增强专家特化，并在不进行架构修改的情况下，相比经典MoE基线性能提升高达23.79%。
AI.keywords: 专家混合模型, 专家特化, 负载均衡, 正交性损失, 方差损失
AI.comments: 该研究针对MoE模型中负载均衡损失导致的专家重叠和路由过于均匀的问题，提出了正交性和方差损失两个互补目标，有效促进了专家特化，并在不进行架构修改的情况下显著提升了性能，具有较高的创新性和实用价值。

title: Visual Explanation via Similar Feature Activation for Metric Learning
summary: Visual explanation maps enhance the trustworthiness of decisions made by deep learning models and offer valuable guidance for developing new algorithms in image recognition tasks. Class activation maps (CAM) and their variants (e.g., Grad-CAM and Relevance-CAM) have been extensively employed to explore the interpretability of softmax-based convolutional neural networks, which require a fully connected layer as the classifier for decision-making. However, these methods cannot be directly applied to metric learning models, as such models lack a fully connected layer functioning as a classifier. To address this limitation, we propose a novel visual explanation method termed Similar Feature Activation Map (SFAM). This method introduces the channel-wise contribution importance score (CIS) to measure feature importance, derived from the similarity measurement between two image embeddings. The explanation map is constructed by linearly combining the proposed importance weights with the feature map from a CNN model. Quantitative and qualitative experiments show that SFAM provides highly promising interpretable visual explanations for CNN models using Euclidean distance or cosine similarity as the similarity metric.

AI.title_translation: 通过相似特征激活进行视觉解释的度量学习
AI.tldr: 针对无法解释度量学习模型的现有视觉解释方法的缺点，提出SFAM方法，该方法通过衡量特征相似性来计算特征重要性得分，并生成视觉解释图，实验证明其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉解释方法（如CAM及其变体）主要针对基于Softmax的CNN模型，这些模型包含一个作为分类器的全连接层，但这些方法不能直接应用于缺乏全连接层的度量学习模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为相似特征激活图（SFAM）的新型视觉解释方法。该方法通过衡量两个图像嵌入之间的相似性，引入了通道级贡献重要性得分（CIS）来衡量特征重要性。解释图通过将所提出的重要性权重与CNN模型的特征图线性组合来构建。
AI.result: 定量和定性实验表明，SFAM为使用欧氏距离或余弦相似度作为相似性度量的CNN模型提供了非常有希望的可解释视觉解释。
AI.conclusion: SFAM为使用欧氏距离或余弦相似度作为相似性度量的CNN模型提供了非常有希望的可解释视觉解释。
AI.translation: 视觉解释图增强了深度学习模型决策的可信度，并为图像识别任务中新算法的开发提供了宝贵指导。类别激活图（CAM）及其变体（例如Grad-CAM和Relevance-CAM）已被广泛用于探索基于Softmax的卷积神经网络的可解释性，这些网络需要一个作为分类器的全连接层来进行决策。然而，这些方法不能直接应用于度量学习模型，因为此类模型缺乏充当分类器的全连接层。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的视觉解释方法，称为相似特征激活图（SFAM）。该方法引入了通道级贡献重要性得分（CIS）来衡量特征重要性，该得分源于两个图像嵌入之间的相似性度量。解释图是通过将所提出的重要性权重与CNN模型的特征图线性组合来构建的。定量和定性实验表明，SFAM为使用欧氏距离或余弦相似度作为相似性度量的CNN模型提供了非常有希望的可解释视觉解释。
AI.summary: 本文针对度量学习模型缺乏全连接层而无法直接应用现有视觉解释方法的局限性，提出了一种新的方法——相似特征激活图（SFAM）。SFAM通过计算特征相似性来获得通道级贡献重要性得分（CIS），并结合特征图生成解释图，成功地为度量学习模型提供了有效的视觉解释。
AI.keywords: 视觉解释,度量学习,特征激活图,通道级贡献重要性得分,可解释性
AI.comments: 该方法的主要创新在于提出了通道级贡献重要性得分（CIS）来衡量特征重要性，从而使视觉解释方法能够应用于缺乏全连接层的度量学习模型，这是对现有CAM类方法的显著扩展。其实用性和有效性已通过实验证明。

title: WANDER: An Explainable Decision-Support Framework for HPC
summary: High-performance computing (HPC) systems expose many interdependent configuration knobs that impact runtime, resource usage, power, and variability. Existing predictive tools model these outcomes, but do not support structured exploration, explanation, or guided reconfiguration. We present WANDER, a decision-support framework that synthesizes alternate configurations using counterfactual analysis aligned with user goals and constraints. We introduce a composite trade-off score that ranks suggestions based on prediction uncertainty, consistency between feature-target relationships using causal models, and similarity between feature distributions against historical data. To our knowledge, WANDER is the first such system to unify prediction, exploration, and explanation for HPC tuning under a common query interface. Across multiple datasets WANDER generates interpretable and trustworthy, human-readable alternatives that guide users to achieve their performance objectives.

AI.title_translation: WANDER：一个用于高性能计算（HPC）的可解释决策支持框架
AI.tldr: WANDER是一个HPC决策支持框架，使用反事实分析生成可解释的配置建议，统一了预测、探索和解释功能，帮助用户优化系统性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的HPC预测工具仅能对运行时、资源使用、功耗和变化性等结果进行建模，但不支持结构化的探索、解释或引导式重配置，而HPC系统暴露了许多相互依赖的配置旋钮。
AI.method: WANDER通过反事实分析综合替代配置，这些分析与用户目标和约束保持一致。它引入了一个复合权衡分数来根据预测不确定性、使用因果模型特征-目标关系的一致性，以及与历史数据的特征分布相似性来对建议进行排序。
AI.result: WANDER生成了可解释和可信赖的、人类可读的替代方案，指导用户实现其性能目标。
AI.conclusion: WANDER生成了可解释和可信赖的人类可读的替代方案，指导用户实现其性能目标。
AI.translation: 高性能计算（HPC）系统暴露了许多相互依赖的配置旋钮，这些旋钮会影响运行时间、资源使用、功耗和变化性。现有的预测工具对这些结果进行建模，但不支持结构化探索、解释或引导式重配置。我们提出了WANDER，一个决策支持框架，它使用与用户目标和约束对齐的反事实分析来综合替代配置。我们引入了一个复合权衡分数，该分数根据预测不确定性、使用因果模型特征-目标关系的一致性，以及与历史数据的特征分布相似性来对建议进行排序。据我们所知，WANDER是第一个在通用查询接口下统一HPC调优中的预测、探索和解释的此类系统。在多个数据集上，WANDER生成了可解释和可信赖的、人类可读的替代方案，以指导用户实现其性能目标。
AI.summary: WANDER是一个用于高性能计算（HPC）的决策支持框架，旨在解决现有工具无法提供结构化探索、解释和引导式重配置的问题。它利用反事实分析生成符合用户目标和约束的替代配置，并通过一个综合的权衡分数来评估这些建议的可信度和有效性。WANDER是首个统一了HPC调优中预测、探索和解释的系统。
AI.keywords: HPC, 决策支持, 反事实分析, 可解释性, 配置调优
AI.comments: WANDER的创新之处在于它首次将预测、探索和解释集成到一个统一的查询接口下，用于HPC调优。它通过反事实分析来生成可解释的替代配置，这对于理解复杂系统（如HPC）的决策至关重要。限制方面，抽象中未提及其在实际大规模系统上的性能或扩展性验证。

title: Reward Is Enough: LLMs Are In-Context Reinforcement Learners
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a framework for solving sequential decision-making problems. In this work, we demonstrate that, surprisingly, RL emerges during the inference time of large language models (LLMs), a phenomenon we term in-context RL (ICRL). To reveal this capability, we introduce a simple multi-round prompting framework, we call ICRL prompting, for inference-time self-improvement. The goal of ICRL prompting is to guide LLMs to perform reinforcement learning during inference for self-improvement on a given task. After each response, the model receives numerical scalar feedback, denoted as a reward. In the next round, we prompt the LLM again together with a context that concatenates all prior responses and their associated rewards. We consistently observe that response quality improves as the context grows. In other words, the LLM can optimize scalar reward signals during inference, exhibiting behavior analogous to reinforcement learning. We evaluate ICRL prompting on Game of 24, creative writing, ScienceWorld, and Olympiad-level math competitions (AIME and HMMT), demonstrating significant improvements over baselines such as Self-Refine and Reflexion. Notably, even when the reward signals are generated by the same LLM, ICRL prompting still improves performance, highlighting a promising new paradigm for test-time scaling.

AI.title_translation: 奖励足以：大型语言模型是上下文强化学习者
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理时会表现出强化学习（RL）的行为，称为上下文 RL（ICRL）。通过一个简单的多轮提示框架（ICRL 提示），模型可以接收标量奖励反馈并在后续回合中进行自我改进。ICRL 提示在多个任务上展示了显著的性能提升，甚至在奖励信号由同一 LLM 生成时也是如此，这为测试时扩展开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 在大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理过程中，探索和揭示其潜在的强化学习（RL）能力，并提出一种能够引导 LLMs 在推理时进行自我改进的框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 ICRL 提示的多轮提示框架。在该框架中，模型在每次响应后接收标量奖励反馈，并在下一轮提示中结合历史响应和奖励信息进行自我改进。
AI.result: ICRL 提示在“24 点游戏”、创意写作、ScienceWorld 以及奥林匹克数学竞赛（AIME 和 HMMT）等任务上，相比 Self-Refine 和 Reflexion 等基线方法取得了显著的性能提升。即使奖励信号由同一 LLM 生成，ICRL 提示也能提高性能。
AI.conclusion: ICRL 提示是一种有效的方法，可以使大型语言模型在推理时展现出强化学习的能力，并通过接收标量奖励信号进行自我改进，为模型在测试时的性能扩展提供了一种有前景的新范式。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）是解决序贯决策问题的框架。在本工作中，我们证明了，令人惊讶的是，RL 在大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理过程中出现，我们称之为上下文 RL（ICRL）。为了揭示这种能力，我们引入了一个简单的多轮提示框架，我们称之为 ICRL 提示，用于推理时的自我改进。ICRL 提示的目标是引导 LLMs 在推理时进行强化学习，以在给定任务上进行自我改进。在每次响应后，模型会收到数值标量反馈，表示为奖励。在下一轮中，我们再次提示 LLM，并提供一个连接了所有先前响应及其相关奖励的上下文。我们持续观察到，随着上下文的增长，响应质量会提高。换句话说，LLM 可以在推理时优化标量奖励信号，表现出类似于强化学习的行为。我们在“24 点游戏”、创意写作、ScienceWorld 以及奥林匹克数学竞赛（AIME 和 HMMT）上评估了 ICRL 提示，证明了其相比 Self-Refine 和 Reflexion 等基线方法的显著改进。值得注意的是，即使奖励信号由同一 LLM 生成，ICRL 提示仍然可以提高性能，这凸显了一种有前景的测试时扩展新范式。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“上下文强化学习”（ICRL）的现象，即大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理时能够进行强化学习。研究人员开发了一种名为 ICRL 提示的框架，通过在多轮交互中提供标量奖励信号，引导 LLMs 在推理过程中进行自我优化。实验结果表明，ICRL 提示在多个任务上显著优于现有方法，并且即使奖励由 LLM 本身生成也能有效提升性能，为 LLMs 的测试时性能扩展提供了一种新的有效途径。
AI.keywords: 上下文强化学习, 大型语言模型, 推理时自我改进, ICRL 提示, 标量奖励
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了大型语言模型在推理过程中进行强化学习的惊人能力，并提出了一个简单而有效的 ICRL 提示框架。该方法在多个基准测试中取得了优于现有方法的性能，并且其在奖励信号由同一模型生成时依然有效的特性，使其在实际应用中具有广泛的潜力。然而，对于奖励信号的质量、数量以及其对模型行为的长期影响，还需要进一步的研究。

title: Accelerating Diffusion Planners in Offline RL via Reward-Aware Consistency Trajectory Distillation
summary: Although diffusion models have achieved strong results in decision-making tasks, their slow inference speed remains a key limitation. While consistency models offer a potential solution, existing applications to decision-making either struggle with suboptimal demonstrations under behavior cloning or rely on complex concurrent training of multiple networks under the actor-critic framework. In this work, we propose a novel approach to consistency distillation for offline reinforcement learning that directly incorporates reward optimization into the distillation process. Our method achieves single-step sampling while generating higher-reward action trajectories through decoupled training and noise-free reward signals. Empirical evaluations on the Gym MuJoCo, FrankaKitchen, and long horizon planning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach can achieve a 9.7% improvement over previous state-of-the-art while offering up to 142x speedup over diffusion counterparts in inference time.

AI.title_translation: 通过奖励感知一致性轨迹蒸馏加速离线强化学习中的扩散规划器
AI.tldr: 为了解决扩散规划器推理慢的问题，我们提出了一种新的将奖励优化融入离线RL一致性蒸馏的方法，该方法实现了高达142倍的速度提升，同时性能提高了9.7%。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在决策任务中存在推理速度慢的局限性，而现有的一致性模型应用要么在次优演示下表现不佳，要么依赖于复杂的Actor-Critic框架下的多网络并发训练。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的、将奖励优化直接纳入蒸馏过程的离线强化学习一致性蒸馏方法，通过解耦训练和无噪声奖励信号实现单步采样。
AI.result: 实现了单步采样，生成了更高奖励的动作轨迹，在Gym MuJoCo、FrankaKitchen和长视界规划基准测试上，相比现有最先进方法提高了9.7%，推理时间比扩散模型快了142倍。
AI.translation: 尽管扩散模型在决策任务中取得了良好的成果，但其缓慢的推理速度仍然是一个关键限制。虽然一致性模型提供了潜在的解决方案，但现有在决策中的应用要么在次优演示下受限于行为克隆，要么依赖于Actor-Critic框架下多个网络的复杂并发训练。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的离线强化学习一致性蒸馏方法，该方法将奖励优化直接纳入蒸馏过程。我们的方法实现了单步采样，同时通过解耦训练和无噪声奖励信号生成了更高奖励的动作轨迹。在Gym MuJoCo、FrankaKitchen和长视界规划基准测试上的实证评估表明，我们的方法在推理时间上比扩散模型提高了142倍，同时比现有最先进方法提高了9.7%。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种新的、面向离线强化学习的奖励感知一致性轨迹蒸馏方法，通过在蒸馏过程中直接整合奖励优化，实现了扩散规划器的快速单步推理，同时生成了更高质量的动作轨迹，并在多个基准测试中显著超越了现有方法的速度和性能。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 一致性模型, 离线强化学习, 轨迹蒸馏, 奖励感知
AI.comments: 该工作创新性地将奖励优化整合到一致性蒸馏过程中，解决了现有一致性模型在决策应用中面临的次优演示和复杂训练问题，实现了快速推理和高回报轨迹生成。其重要性在于显著提升了离线强化学习中扩散规划器的推理速度和性能。局限性未在摘要中明确提及。

title: Unveiling the Learning Mind of Language Models: A Cognitive Framework and Empirical Study
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive capabilities across tasks such as mathematics, coding, and reasoning, yet their learning ability, which is crucial for adapting to dynamic environments and acquiring new knowledge, remains underexplored. In this work, we address this gap by introducing a framework inspired by cognitive psychology and education. Specifically, we decompose general learning ability into three distinct, complementary dimensions: Learning from Instructor (acquiring knowledge via explicit guidance), Learning from Concept (internalizing abstract structures and generalizing to new contexts), and Learning from Experience (adapting through accumulated exploration and feedback). We conduct a comprehensive empirical study across the three learning dimensions and identify several insightful findings, such as (i) interaction improves learning; (ii) conceptual understanding is scale-emergent and benefits larger models; and (iii) LLMs are effective few-shot learners but not many-shot learners. Based on our framework and empirical findings, we introduce a benchmark that provides a unified and realistic evaluation of LLMs' general learning abilities across three learning cognition dimensions. It enables diagnostic insights and supports evaluation and development of more adaptive and human-like models.

AI.title_translation: 揭示语言模型的学习心智：一个认知框架与实证研究
AI.tldr: 研究人员提出了一个基于认知心理学的框架，将LLM的学习能力分解为三个维度（从指导者、概念、经验中学习），并通过实验发现交互重要、概念理解依赖规模、少样本学习优于多样本学习，并据此创建了一个新的评估基准。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在数学、编码和推理等方面表现出色，但其适应动态环境和获取新知识所必需的学习能力仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出一个受认知心理学和教育学启发的框架，将通用学习能力分解为“从指导者学习”、“从概念学习”和“从经验学习”三个维度，并据此进行全面的实证研究。
AI.result: 实证研究发现：（i）交互可以提高学习效果；（ii）概念理解是规模涌现的，并使更大的模型受益；（iii）LLMs是有效的少样本学习者，但不是多样本学习者。
AI.conclusion: 基于所提出的框架和实证发现，研究人员引入了一个基准，用于跨越三个学习认知维度对LLMs的通用学习能力进行统一和真实的评估，从而提供诊断性见解，并支持开发更具适应性和更像人类的模型。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在数学、编码和推理等任务中展现出令人印象深刻的能力，然而，对于适应动态环境和获取新知识至关重要的学习能力仍然研究不足。在这项工作中，我们通过引入一个受认知心理学和教育学启发的框架来解决这一差距。具体来说，我们将通用学习能力分解为三个不同且互补的维度：从指导者处学习（通过明确指导获取知识）、从概念处学习（内化抽象结构并推广到新情境）以及从经验中学习（通过积累的探索和反馈进行适应）。我们对三个学习维度进行了全面的实证研究，并发现了一些有见地的结果，例如（i）交互提高了学习效果；（ii）概念理解是规模涌现的，并使更大的模型受益；（iii）LLMs是有效的少样本学习者，但不是多样本学习者。基于我们的框架和实证发现，我们引入了一个基准，它提供了跨越三个学习认知维度的LLMs通用学习能力的统一和真实的评估。它支持诊断性见解，并支持开发更具适应性和更像人类的模型。
AI.summary: 本研究针对大型语言模型（LLMs）学习能力研究的不足，引入了一个受认知心理学启发的框架，将学习能力分解为从指导者、概念和经验中学习三个维度。通过实证研究，揭示了交互对学习的积极作用、概念理解的规模涌现性以及LLMs在少样本学习上的优势。最终，研究提出了一个统一的基准，用于全面评估和诊断LLMs的通用学习能力。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 学习能力, 认知框架, 概念学习, 经验学习
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于首次将认知心理学与教育学的原理引入LLM的学习能力评估，提出了一个三维度的分解框架，这为理解和改进LLMs的学习机制提供了新的视角。其重要性在于提供了一个更全面、更贴近人类学习的评估基准。然而，该研究的局限性可能在于其认知框架是否能完全捕捉人类学习的复杂性，以及所提出的基准在多大程度上能泛化到未知的学习任务。

title: Plaintext-Scale Fair Data Exchange
comments: This is a revised and polished version of the earlier submission, to be published in the proceedings of the Financial Cryptography and Data Security (FC) conference
summary: The Fair Data Exchange (FDE) protocol (CCS'24) achieves atomic, pay-per-file exchange with a constant on-chain footprint, but existing implementations do not scale: proof verification can take hours even for files of only tens of megabytes. In this work, we present two FDE implementations: VECKplus and VECKstar. VECKplus reduces client-side verification to O(lambda) -- independent of file size -- where lambda is the security parameter. VECKplus brings verification time to approximately 1 s on a commodity desktop for any file size. VECKplus also significantly reduces proof generation time by limiting expensive range proofs to a Theta(lambda)-sized subset of the file. This improvement is especially beneficial for large files, even though proof generation and encryption are already precomputable and highly parallelizable on the server: for a 32 MiB file, for instance, proof generation time drops from approximately 6,295 s to approximately 4.8 s (approximately 1,300x speed-up). As in the existing ElGamal implementation, however, VECKplus retains exponential ElGamal over the full file. Consequently, the client must perform ElGamal decryption and download ciphertexts that are at least 10x the plaintext size. We address both drawbacks in the second implementation, VECKstar: we replace bulk ElGamal encryption with a fast, hash-derived mask and confine public-key work to a Theta(lambda) sample tied together with a file-size-independent zk-SNARK, adding less than 0.1 s to verification in our prototype. Importantly, this also reduces the communication overhead from at least 10x to less than 50%. Together, these changes yield plaintext-scale performance. Finally, we bridge Bitcoin's secp256k1 and BLS12-381 with a file-size-independent zk-SNARK to run FDE fully off-chain over the Lightning Network, reducing fees from approximately USD 10 to less than USD 0.01 and payment latency to a few seconds.
comment: This is a revised and polished version of the earlier submission, to be published in the proceedings of the Financial Cryptography and Data Security (FC) conference

AI.title_translation: 明文规模公平数据交换
AI.tldr: VECKplus和VECKstar是新的公平数据交换(FDE)协议实现，它们通过优化验证和证明生成过程，显著提高了数据交换的效率和可扩展性，使之能够处理更大规模的文件，并降低了交易成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的公平数据交换(FDE)协议实现存在可扩展性问题，即使是几十兆字节的文件，验证时间也可能长达数小时。
AI.method: 提出了两种新的FDE实现：VECKplus和VECKstar。VECKplus将客户端验证时间复杂度降低到O(lambda)，并限制了昂贵的范围证明的计算量。VECKstar进一步用哈希派生的掩码替换了ElGamal加密，并将公钥操作限制在与文件大小无关的zk-SNARK中。此外，还实现了将FDE完全运行在闪电网络上，以降低交易费用和延迟。
AI.result: VECKplus将任何文件大小的验证时间缩短到大约1秒，并将32MiB文件的证明生成时间从约6295秒缩短到约4.8秒（约1300倍的加速）。VECKstar将通信开销从至少10倍减少到不到50%，使性能达到明文级别。在闪电网络上运行FDE将费用从约10美元降至不到0.01美元，支付延迟降至几秒钟。
AI.conclusion: 通过VECKplus和VECKstar的优化以及在闪电网络上的集成，实现了明文级别的数据交换性能，解决了现有FDE协议的可扩展性问题，并显著降低了交易成本和延迟。
AI.translation: 公平数据交换（FDE）协议（CCS'24）实现了原子化的、按文件付费的交换，并且具有恒定的链上开销。然而，现有的实现并不能很好地扩展：即使对于只有几十兆字节的文件，证明验证也可能需要数小时。在这项工作中，我们提出了两种FDE实现：VECKplus和VECKstar。VECKplus将客户端验证的复杂度降低到O(lambda)，其中lambda是安全参数，与文件大小无关。VECKplus将验证时间缩短到商品台式机上大约1秒，适用于任何文件大小。VECKplus还通过将昂贵的范围证明限制在文件中Theta(lambda)大小的子集来显著减少证明生成时间。这种改进对于大文件尤其有益，尽管证明生成和加密在服务器上已经是可预计算且高度可并行化的：例如，对于一个32MiB的文件，证明生成时间从大约6,295秒减少到大约4.8秒（约1300倍的加速）。然而，与现有的ElGamal实现一样，VECKplus在整个文件上保留了指数级的ElGamal操作。因此，客户端必须执行ElGamal解密并下载至少是明文大小10倍的密文。我们在第二种实现VECKstar中解决了这两个缺点：我们用一个快速的、派生自哈希的掩码替换了批量ElGamal加密，并将公钥操作限制在一个Theta(lambda)的样本中，该样本与一个与文件大小无关的zk-SNARK绑定在一起，在我们的原型中验证时间增加了不到0.1秒。重要的是，这也将通信开销从至少10倍减少到不到50%。这些变化共同实现了明文级别的数据交换性能。最后，我们将比特币的secp256k1和BLS12-381连接起来，使用一个与文件大小无关的zk-SNARK，在闪电网络上完全离线运行FDE，将费用从大约10美元降至不到0.01美元，并将支付延迟降至几秒钟。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了两种新的公平数据交换（FDE）协议实现——VECKplus和VECKstar，旨在解决现有FDE协议在可扩展性方面的问题。VECKplus通过优化验证和证明生成过程，显著提高了处理大文件的效率。VECKstar进一步通过替换加密方式和使用zk-SNARK，实现了接近明文大小的性能和更低的通信开销。最后，通过在闪电网络上运行FDE，大幅降低了交易费用和延迟，实现了高效、低成本的数据交换。
AI.keywords: 公平数据交换, VECKplus, VECKstar, zk-SNARK, 闪电网络
AI.comments: 这项工作在提高公平数据交换（FDE）协议的可扩展性和效率方面取得了显著进展。通过引入VECKplus和VECKstar两种新实现，并结合闪电网络的支持，论文有效地解决了现有FDE协议在处理大文件、验证时间和交易成本方面的痛点。特别是将验证时间缩短至秒级，以及将交易费用降低至美分级别，使得大规模、低成本的数据交换成为可能。然而，论文中关于zk-SNARK的具体细节和安全性分析可以进一步阐述。

title: Compliant Residual DAgger: Improving Real-World Contact-Rich Manipulation with Human Corrections
summary: We address key challenges in Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) for real-world contact-rich manipulation: how to collect informative human correction data and how to effectively update policies with this new data. We introduce Compliant Residual DAgger (CR-DAgger), which contains two novel components: 1) a Compliant Intervention Interface that leverages compliance control, allowing humans to provide gentle, accurate delta action corrections without interrupting the ongoing robot policy execution; and 2) a Compliant Residual Policy formulation that learns from human corrections while incorporating force feedback and force control. Our system significantly enhances performance on precise contact-rich manipulation tasks using minimal correction data, improving base policy success rates by 64% on four challenging tasks (book flipping, belt assembly, cable routing, and gear insertion) while outperforming both retraining-from-scratch and finetuning approaches. Through extensive real-world experiments, we provide practical guidance for implementing effective DAgger in real-world robot learning tasks. Result videos are available at: https://compliant-residual-dagger.github.io

AI.title_translation: 柔顺残差DAgger：利用人类修正改进真实世界接触丰富操作
AI.tldr: CR-DAgger通过一种新的、无需中断的、基于力反馈的柔顺人类修正方法，显著提高了机器人在复杂接触任务上的表现，比传统方法更有效。
AI.motivation: 解决在真实世界接触丰富操作中，DAgger面临的如何收集信息量大的人类修正数据以及如何有效地使用新数据更新策略的关键挑战。
AI.method: CR-DAgger包含两个新组件：1) 柔顺干预接口（Compliant Intervention Interface），利用柔顺控制，允许人类提供温和、精确的增量动作修正而不中断现有策略执行；2) 柔顺残差策略（Compliant Residual Policy）配方，在从人类修正中学习的同时，整合了力反馈和力控制。
AI.result: 在四个具有挑战性的任务（翻书、皮带组装、电缆布线和齿轮插入）上，CR-DAgger将基础策略的成功率提高了64%，并且优于从头训练和微调方法。
AI.conclusion: CR-DAgger通过其实验验证，显著提高了机器人在精确接触式操作任务上的成功率，并优于从头训练和微调方法，为在真实世界机器人学习中使用DAgger提供了实用的指导。
AI.translation: 我们解决了真实世界接触丰富操作中数据集聚合（DAgger）的关键挑战：如何收集信息量大的人类修正数据以及如何有效地使用这些新数据更新策略。我们引入了Compliant Residual DAgger (CR-DAgger)，它包含两个新颖的组件：1) 一个利用柔顺控制的柔顺干预接口，允许人类在不中断正在执行的机器人策略的情况下，提供温和、精确的增量动作修正；2) 一个学习人类修正的同时结合力反馈和力控制的柔顺残差策略配方。我们的系统使用最少量的修正数据，显著提高了精确接触丰富操作任务的性能，在四个具有挑战性的任务（翻书、皮带组装、电缆布线和齿轮插入）上将基础策略的成功率提高了64%，同时优于从头训练和微调方法。通过广泛的真实世界实验，我们为在真实世界机器人学习任务中实施有效的DAgger提供了实用指导。结果视频可访问：https://compliant-residual-dagger.github.io
AI.summary: 本文提出了Compliant Residual DAgger (CR-DAgger) 框架，旨在解决真实世界接触丰富操作中数据收集和策略更新的难题。CR-DAgger通过引入柔顺干预接口和柔顺残差策略配方，使得人类可以在不中断机器人执行的情况下提供精确的动作修正，并有效整合力反馈进行学习。实验证明，该方法仅用少量修正数据就能显著提升机器人在复杂任务上的性能。
AI.keywords: DAgger, 接触丰富操作, 柔顺干预, 残差策略, 人类修正
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一个结合了柔顺干预和残差学习的DAgger框架，解决了真实世界中数据采集和策略更新的难题。其核心贡献在于无需中断机器人执行即可进行精确的增量式动作修正。该方法在复杂接触操作任务上的性能提升显著，为实际机器人学习提供了有价值的指导。

title: A new machine learning framework for occupational accidents forecasting with safety inspections integration
summary: We propose a generic framework for short-term occupational accident forecasting that leverages safety inspections and models accident occurrences as binary time series. The approach generates daily predictions, which are then aggregated into weekly safety assessments to better inform decision making. To ensure the reliability and operational applicability of the forecasts, we apply a sliding-window cross-validation procedure specifically designed for time series data, combined with an evaluation based on aggregated period-level metrics. Several machine learning algorithms, including logistic regression, tree-based models, and neural networks, are trained and systematically compared within this framework. Unlike the other approaches, the long short-term memory (LSTM) network outperforms the other approaches and detects the upcoming high-risk periods with a balanced accuracy of 0.86, confirming the robustness of our methodology and demonstrating that a binary time series model can anticipate these critical periods based on safety inspections. The proposed methodology converts routine safety inspection data into clear weekly risk scores, detecting the periods when accidents are most likely. Decision-makers can integrate these scores into their planning tools to classify inspection priorities, schedule targeted interventions, and funnel resources to the sites or shifts classified as highest risk, stepping in before incidents occur and getting the greatest return on safety investments.

AI.title_translation: 一种集成安全检查的职业事故预测新机器学习框架
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种新的机器学习框架，使用安全检查数据将事故建模为二元时间序列，用于短期事故预测。LSTM模型表现最好，准确率为0.86，能够生成每周风险评分，帮助决策者在事故发生前优先处理高风险区域。
AI.motivation: 旨在开发一个通用的短期职业事故预测框架，该框架能够利用安全检查数据，并通过生成每日预测和周安全评估来更好地为决策提供信息，从而实现事故的先发制人预防。
AI.method: 提出了一个利用安全检查数据，将事故发生建模为二元时间序列的通用框架。采用专门为时间序列数据设计的滑动窗口交叉验证程序，并基于聚合周期级指标进行评估。在该框架内系统地训练和比较了逻辑回归、基于树的模型和神经网络等多种机器学习算法，其中长短期记忆（LSTM）网络表现最佳。
AI.result: 长短期记忆（LSTM）网络在所有比较的模型中表现最佳，以0.86的平衡准确率检测到即将到来的高风险时期，确认了该方法的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法（特别是LSTM模型）能够基于安全检查数据，以0.86的平衡准确率成功地预测即将到来的高风险时期，证实了该方法的稳健性，并表明二元时间序列模型可以有效地利用安全检查信息来预测关键时期。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个通用的短期职业事故预测框架，该框架利用安全检查并将事故发生建模为二元时间序列。该方法生成每日预测，然后汇总成每周安全评估，以更好地为决策提供信息。为确保预测的可靠性和操作适用性，我们应用了专门为时间序列数据设计的滑动窗口交叉验证程序，并结合基于聚合周期级指标的评估。在该框架内训练并系统地比较了几种机器学习算法，包括逻辑回归、基于树的模型和神经网络。与其它方法不同，长短期记忆（LSTM）网络优于其它方法，并以0.86的平衡准确率检测到即将到来的高风险时期，证实了我们方法的稳健性，并表明二元时间序列模型可以基于安全检查来预测这些关键时期。所提出的方法将日常安全检查数据转化为清晰的每周风险评分，检测出最有可能发生事故的时期。决策者可以将这些评分整合到他们的规划工具中，以对检查进行分类、安排有针对性的干预措施，并将资源集中到被分类为最高风险的地点或班次，在事件发生前进行干预，从而获得最大的安全投资回报。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的机器学习框架，用于短期职业事故预测，该框架将安全检查数据纳入二元时间序列模型。通过滑动窗口交叉验证和多种算法的比较，研究发现长短期记忆（LSTM）网络表现最佳，能以0.86的平衡准确率预测高风险时期。该方法将日常安全检查转化为清晰的周风险评分，为决策者提供可操作的指导，以优先安排检查、干预和资源分配，从而在事故发生前进行干预。
AI.keywords: 职业事故预测, 安全检查, 二元时间序列, 机器学习, LSTM
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将安全检查数据与二元时间序列模型相结合，用于短期职业事故的预测。其重要性在于提供了一种可操作的、基于风险评分的决策支持工具，以实现事故的先发制人预防。方法的局限性可能在于其对短时预测的关注，可能未能捕捉到长期趋势。

title: Shared & Domain Self-Adaptive Experts with Frequency-Aware Discrimination for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
summary: This paper focuses on the Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) task, aiming to enable an agent to continuously adapt to evolving target domains while retaining previously acquired domain knowledge for effective reuse when those domains reappear. Existing shared-parameter paradigms struggle to balance adaptation and forgetting, leading to decreased efficiency and stability. To address this, we propose a frequency-aware shared and self-adaptive expert framework, consisting of two key components: (i) a dual-branch expert architecture that extracts general features and dynamically models domain-specific representations, effectively reducing cross-domain interference and repetitive learning cost; and (ii) an online Frequency-aware Domain Discriminator (FDD), which leverages the robustness of low-frequency image signals for online domain shift detection, guiding dynamic allocation of expert resources for more stable and realistic adaptation. Additionally, we introduce a Continual Repeated Shifts (CRS) benchmark to simulate periodic domain changes for more realistic evaluation. Experimental results show that our method consistently outperforms existing approaches on both classification and segmentation CTTA tasks under standard and CRS settings, with ablations and visualizations confirming its effectiveness and robustness. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJC25127/Domain-Self-Adaptive-CTTA.git.

AI.title_translation: 持续测试时间自适应的共享与领域自适应专家及其频率感知判别
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种新的持续测试时间自适应（CTTA）框架，通过共享和自适应专家以及频率感知判别器来解决现有方法的不足，以应对不断变化的领域并保留旧知识。实验证明该方法在分类和分割任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有共享参数方法难以平衡适应性和遗忘性，导致效率和稳定性降低。
AI.method: 提出了一种频率感知的共享和自适应专家框架，包括一个双分支专家架构（提取通用特征并动态建模领域特定表示）和一个在线频率感知领域判别器（FDD）（利用低频信号检测领域漂移并指导专家资源分配）。此外，还引入了持续重复移位（CRS）基准来模拟周期性领域变化。
AI.result: 在分类和分割的CTTA任务上，该方法在标准和CRS设置下均持续优于现有方法。消融实验和可视化证实了其有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的频率感知的共享和自适应专家框架能有效解决CTTA中的挑战，实现更稳定和真实的适应性，并在各种实验设置下均表现出优越性能。
AI.translation: 本文聚焦于持续测试时间自适应（CTTA）任务，旨在使智能体能够持续适应不断变化的的目标域，同时保留先前获得的领域知识，以便在这些域再次出现时进行有效重用。现有的共享参数范式在平衡适应性和遗忘性方面存在困难，导致效率和稳定性下降。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种频率感知的共享和自适应专家框架，包含两个关键组成部分：（一）双分支专家架构，用于提取通用特征并动态建模领域特定的表示，有效减少跨领域干扰和重复学习成本；（二）在线频率感知领域判别器（FDD），利用低频图像信号的鲁棒性进行在线领域漂移检测，指导专家资源的动态分配，以实现更稳定和真实的适应性。此外，我们引入了持续重复移位（CRS）基准来模拟周期性领域变化，以进行更真实的评估。实验结果表明，我们的方法在标准和CRS设置下的分类和分割CTTA任务上均持续优于现有方法，消融实验和可视化证实了其有效性和鲁棒性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ZJC25127/Domain-Self-Adaptive-CTTA.git获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的持续测试时间自适应（CTTA）框架，采用双分支专家架构和频率感知领域判别器（FDD），以克服现有方法在平衡适应性与遗忘性方面的局限性。该框架通过提取通用特征和动态建模领域特定表示来减少干扰，并利用低频信号进行在线领域漂移检测以优化资源分配。此外，还引入了CRS基准以模拟更真实的周期性领域变化。实验证明，该方法在分类和分割任务上均显著优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: 持续测试时间自适应, 领域自适应, 共享专家, 频率感知, 领域漂移
AI.comments: 该研究提出的频率感知共享和自适应专家框架在CTTA领域具有创新性，尤其是在利用低频信号进行领域漂移检测方面。引入CRS基准也为评估CTTA方法的鲁棒性提供了更现实的场景。然而，框架的计算复杂度以及在极端或快速变化的领域漂移下的表现仍有待进一步研究。

title: PhysicsCorrect: A Training-Free Approach for Stable Neural PDE Simulations
summary: Neural networks have emerged as powerful surrogates for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), offering significant computational speedups over traditional methods. However, these models suffer from a critical limitation: error accumulation during long-term rollouts, where small inaccuracies compound exponentially, eventually causing complete divergence from physically valid solutions. We present PhysicsCorrect, a training-free correction framework that enforces PDE consistency at each prediction step by formulating correction as a linearized inverse problem based on PDE residuals. Our key innovation is an efficient caching strategy that precomputes the Jacobian and its pseudoinverse during an offline warm-up phase, reducing computational overhead by two orders of magnitude compared to standard correction approaches. Across three representative PDE systems, including Navier-Stokes fluid dynamics, wave equations, and the chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation, PhysicsCorrect reduces prediction errors by up to 100x while adding negligible inference time (under 5%). The framework integrates seamlessly with diverse architectures, including Fourier Neural Operators, UNets, and Vision Transformers, effectively transforming unstable neural surrogates into reliable simulation tools that bridge the gap between deep learning's computational efficiency and the physical fidelity demanded by practical scientific applications.

AI.title_translation: PhysicsCorrect：一种用于稳定神经PDE模拟的训练无关方法
AI.tldr: PhysicsCorrect是一个“即插即用”的训练后修正方法，它通过高效的线性化逆问题求解（利用预缓存的雅可比矩阵）来修复神经网络在长期模拟PDE时产生的物理错误和发散问题，使模型在不牺牲速度的情况下变得稳定可靠。
AI.motivation: 传统的神经PDE求解器在长期预测（rollouts）中存在关键限制，即误差会随着时间呈指数级累积，最终导致完全偏离物理有效解。
AI.method: PhysicsCorrect是一个训练无关的校正框架，它通过将校正问题构建为基于PDE残差的线性化逆问题来强制执行每一步的PDE一致性。其关键创新是引入了高效的缓存策略，在离线预热阶段预计算雅可比矩阵及其伪逆，从而将计算开销降低了两个数量级。
AI.result: 在纳维-斯托克斯流体动力学、波动方程和混沌的近藤-涩川-寺田（Kuramoto-Sivashinsky）方程这三个代表性PDE系统上，PhysicsCorrect将预测误差降低了高达100倍，同时推理时间增加可忽略不计（低于5%）。
AI.conclusion: PhysicsCorrect成功地将不稳定的神经代理模型转变为可靠的模拟工具，弥合了深度学习的计算效率与科学应用对物理保真度的要求之间的差距。
AI.translation: 神经网络已成为求解偏微分方程（PDE）的强大替代方案，与传统方法相比，它提供了显著的计算加速。然而，这些模型存在一个关键限制：在长期滚动预测中，误差会累积，微小的误差会呈指数级增长，最终导致完全偏离物理有效的解。我们提出了PhysicsCorrect，一个训练无关的校正框架，它通过将校正构建为基于PDE残差的线性化逆问题，来强制执行每一步的PDE一致性。我们的关键创新是一种高效的缓存策略，它在离线预热阶段预先计算雅可比矩阵及其伪逆，与标准的校正方法相比，计算开销降低了两个数量级。在包括纳维-斯托克斯流体动力学、波动方程和混沌的近藤-涩川-寺田方程在内的三个代表性PDE系统中，PhysicsCorrect将预测误差降低了高达100倍，同时推理时间增加可忽略不计（低于5%）。该框架与傅里叶神经算子、UNet和视觉Transformer等各种架构无缝集成，有效地将不稳定的神经代理模型转变为可靠的模拟工具，弥合了深度学习的计算效率与实际科学应用对物理保真度的要求之间的差距。
AI.summary: PhysicsCorrect是一种训练无关的校正框架，用于稳定神经PDE模拟。它通过将校正视为基于PDE残差的线性化逆问题来强制执行每一步的物理一致性。通过高效的雅可比矩阵缓存预计算，该方法将计算开销显著降低，并在多个测试方程上实现了高达100倍的误差降低，同时保持了极低的推理时间开销。
AI.keywords: 神经PDE求解, 训练无关, 误差累积, 物理一致性, 雅可比缓存
AI.comments: 该方法的核心创新在于其“训练无关”的特性和高效的雅可比矩阵缓存策略，显著降低了物理一致性校正的计算成本，解决了长期仿真中误差累积导致的发散问题，具有很高的实用价值。

title: S$^2$Edit: Text-Guided Image Editing with Precise Semantic and Spatial Control
summary: Recent advances in diffusion models have enabled high-quality generation and manipulation of images guided by texts, as well as concept learning from images. However, naive applications of existing methods to editing tasks that require fine-grained control, e.g., face editing, often lead to suboptimal solutions with identity information and high-frequency details lost during the editing process, or irrelevant image regions altered due to entangled concepts. In this work, we propose S$^2$Edit, a novel method based on a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model that enables personalized editing with precise semantic and spatial control. We first fine-tune our model to embed the identity information into a learnable text token. During fine-tuning, we disentangle the learned identity token from attributes to be edited by enforcing an orthogonality constraint in the textual feature space. To ensure that the identity token only affects regions of interest, we apply object masks to guide the cross-attention maps. At inference time, our method performs localized editing while faithfully preserving the original identity with semantically disentangled and spatially focused identity token learned. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of S$^2$Edit over state-of-the-art methods both quantitatively and qualitatively. Additionally, we showcase several compositional image editing applications of S$^2$Edit such as makeup transfer.

AI.title_translation: S$^2$Edit：具有精确语义和空间控制的文本引导图像编辑
AI.tldr: S$^2$Edit 是一种新的图像编辑技术，它通过学习一个特殊的身份文本令牌，并使用正交约束和对象掩码来确保编辑只影响目标区域且不丢失原始身份信息，实现了精确的语义和空间控制，在人脸编辑等任务中效果显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本引导的图像编辑方法在需要精细控制（如人脸编辑）的任务中表现不佳，通常会导致身份信息和高频细节丢失，或者由于概念纠缠导致不相关的图像区域被修改。
AI.method: S$^2$Edit 是一种基于预训练文本到图像扩散模型的新方法。它首先通过在学习到的文本令牌中嵌入身份信息，并在微调过程中通过在文本特征空间中强制执行正交性约束来解耦学习到的身份令牌与要编辑的属性。然后，使用对象掩码来指导交叉注意力图，以确保身份令牌仅影响感兴趣的区域。
AI.result: S$^2$Edit 在定量和定性上均证明了其优于现有最先进的方法，并展示了如化妆转移等组合图像编辑应用。
AI.conclusion: S$^2$Edit 能够在进行图像编辑时，忠实地保留原始身份信息，同时实现语义解耦和空间聚焦的身份令牌学习，在定量和定性上均优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.translation: 最近扩散模型的发展使得由文本引导的高质量图像生成和操作，以及从图像中学习概念成为可能。然而，将现有方法简单地应用于需要精细控制的编辑任务（例如人脸编辑）时，往往会导致在编辑过程中身份信息和高频细节丢失，或由于概念纠缠导致不相关的图像区域被修改等次优结果。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法 S$^2$Edit，它基于预训练的文本到图像扩散模型，能够实现具有精确语义和空间控制的个性化编辑。我们首先对模型进行微调，将身份信息嵌入到一个可学习的文本令牌中。在微调过程中，我们通过在文本特征空间中强制执行正交性约束，将学习到的身份令牌与要编辑的属性解耦。为了确保身份令牌只影响感兴趣的区域，我们应用对象掩码来指导交叉注意力图。在推理时，我们的方法在忠实保留原始身份的同时执行局部编辑，通过学习到的语义解耦和空间聚焦的身份令牌实现。大量的实验证明了 S$^2$Edit 在定量和定性上均优于现有最先进的方法。此外，我们还展示了 S$^2$Edit 的几项组合图像编辑应用，例如化妆转移。
AI.summary: S$^2$Edit 是一种新的文本引导图像编辑方法，它通过将身份信息嵌入到可学习的文本令牌中，并利用正交性约束解耦身份与属性，同时使用对象掩码精确控制空间编辑范围，从而实现了精确的语义和空间控制，有效解决了现有方法在细粒度编辑中身份信息丢失和细节退化的问题。
AI.keywords: 文本引导图像编辑, 语义控制, 空间控制, 身份保持, 扩散模型
AI.comments: S$^2$Edit 的创新点在于通过学习可学习的文本令牌来嵌入身份信息，并通过文本特征空间中的正交性约束来解耦身份信息与要编辑的属性，并使用对象掩码来精确控制空间编辑范围，从而解决了现有方法在细粒度编辑中身份信息丢失和细节退化的问题。其实用性很强，尤其是在人脸编辑等需要高精度控制的任务中。

title: MatDecompSDF: High-Fidelity 3D Shape and PBR Material Decomposition from Multi-View Images
summary: We present MatDecompSDF, a novel framework for recovering high-fidelity 3D shapes and decomposing their physically-based material properties from multi-view images. The core challenge of inverse rendering lies in the ill-posed disentanglement of geometry, materials, and illumination from 2D observations. Our method addresses this by jointly optimizing three neural components: a neural Signed Distance Function (SDF) to represent complex geometry, a spatially-varying neural field for predicting PBR material parameters (albedo, roughness, metallic), and an MLP-based model for capturing unknown environmental lighting. The key to our approach is a physically-based differentiable rendering layer that connects these 3D properties to the input images, allowing for end-to-end optimization. We introduce a set of carefully designed physical priors and geometric regularizations, including a material smoothness loss and an Eikonal loss, to effectively constrain the problem and achieve robust decomposition. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets (e.g., DTU) demonstrate that MatDecompSDF surpasses state-of-the-art methods in geometric accuracy, material fidelity, and novel view synthesis. Crucially, our method produces editable and relightable assets that can be seamlessly integrated into standard graphics pipelines, validating its practical utility for digital content creation.

AI.title_translation: MatDecompSDF：从多视角图像中实现高保真3D形状和PBR材质分解
AI.tldr: MatDecompSDF利用神经SDF、PBR材质场和环境光照模型，通过可微渲染和物理正则化，从多视角图像中高保真地重建3D形状和材质，生成可编辑的图形资产。
AI.motivation: 解决逆渲染中的核心挑战：即从2D观测中对几何、材质和光照进行解耦（disentanglement）的不适定问题。
AI.method: 联合优化三个神经组件：用于表示复杂几何的神经SDF、用于预测PBR材质参数（反照率、粗糙度、金属度）的空间变化神经场，以及用于捕获未知环境光照的基于MLP的模型。核心在于使用一个基于物理的可微渲染层实现端到端优化，并引入了材质平滑度和Eikonal损失等物理先验和几何正则化。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界数据集（如DTU）上的广泛实验表明，MatDecompSDF在几何精度、材质保真度和新视角合成方面优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: MatDecompSDF 能够生成高保真、可编辑、可重新照亮的资产，可无缝集成到标准图形管线中，验证了其在数字内容创作中的实用性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了MatDecompSDF，一个用于从多视角图像中恢复高保真3D形状并分解其物理基础材质属性的新颖框架。逆渲染的核心挑战在于从2D观测中解耦几何、材质和光照的不适定性。我们的方法通过联合优化三个神经组件来解决这个问题：一个用于表示复杂几何的神经符号距离函数（SDF），一个用于预测PBR材质参数（反照率、粗糙度、金属度）的空间变化神经场，以及一个用于捕获未知环境光照的基于MLP的模型。我们方法的关键在于一个基于物理的可微渲染层，它将这些3D属性与输入图像连接起来，从而实现端到端优化。我们引入了一组精心设计的物理先验和几何正则化，包括材质平滑度损失和Eikonal损失，以有效地约束问题并实现鲁棒的分解。在合成和真实世界数据集（如DTU）上的广泛实验表明，MatDecompSDF在几何精度、材质保真度和新视角合成方面超越了现有最先进的方法。至关重要的是，我们的方法生成了可编辑且可重新照亮的资产，可以无缝集成到标准图形管线中，验证了其在数字内容创作中的实用性。
AI.summary: MatDecompSDF是一个新颖的框架，用于从多视角图像中恢复高保真的3D形状并分解其物理基础材质属性。它通过联合优化神经SDF、PBR材质场和环境光照模型，并利用基于物理的可微渲染层进行端到端训练，有效解决了逆渲染中的解耦难题。该方法通过引入物理先验和几何正则化，实现了优于现有技术的结果，并生成了可用于标准图形流程的、可编辑和可重新照亮的3D资产。
AI.keywords: 逆渲染, 3D形状恢复, PBR材质分解, 可微渲染, 神经SDF
AI.comments: 该方法的主要创新点在于它联合优化了SDF、PBR材质场和环境光照模型，并通过一个基于物理的可微渲染层实现了端到端优化，同时引入了物理先验和几何正则化来解决逆渲染中的不适定问题。其重要性在于能生成高保真、可编辑、可重新照亮的3D资产。局限性在于依赖于多视角图像输入。

title: Video Event Reasoning and Prediction by Fusing World Knowledge from LLMs with Vision Foundation Models
summary: Current video understanding models excel at recognizing "what" is happening but fall short in high-level cognitive tasks like causal reasoning and future prediction, a limitation rooted in their lack of commonsense world knowledge. To bridge this cognitive gap, we propose a novel framework that synergistically fuses a powerful Vision Foundation Model (VFM) for deep visual perception with a Large Language Model (LLM) serving as a knowledge-driven reasoning core. Our key technical innovation is a sophisticated fusion module, inspired by the Q-Former architecture, which distills complex spatiotemporal and object-centric visual features into a concise, language-aligned representation. This enables the LLM to effectively ground its inferential processes in direct visual evidence. The model is trained via a two-stage strategy, beginning with large-scale alignment pre-training on video-text data, followed by targeted instruction fine-tuning on a curated dataset designed to elicit advanced reasoning and prediction skills. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple challenging benchmarks. Notably, it exhibits remarkable zero-shot generalization to unseen reasoning tasks, and our in-depth ablation studies validate the critical contribution of each architectural component. This work pushes the boundary of machine perception from simple recognition towards genuine cognitive understanding, paving the way for more intelligent and capable AI systems in robotics, human-computer interaction, and beyond.

AI.title_translation: 通过融合大型语言模型的世界知识与视觉基础模型进行视频事件推理与预测
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种新颖的框架，将视觉基础模型（VFM）与大型语言模型（LLM）融合，以提升视频事件的因果推理和未来预测能力。该框架通过一个创新的融合模块将视觉特征转化为语言可理解的表示，使LLM能够基于视觉证据进行推理。模型经过两阶段训练，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，展现出优秀的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解模型在识别“发生了什么”方面表现良好，但在因果推理和未来预测等高级认知任务方面存在不足，这是因为它们缺乏常识性世界知识。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的框架，将视觉基础模型（VFM）与大型语言模型（LLM）融合。核心创新在于一个受Q-Former启发的融合模块，用于将时空和以物体为中心的视觉特征提炼成简洁的、与语言对齐的表示，从而使LLM能够基于视觉证据进行推理。模型采用两阶段训练策略：首先在大规模视频-文本数据上进行对齐预训练，然后在一个精心设计的、用于激发高级推理和预测技能的数据集上进行指令微调。
AI.result: 该模型在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，并展现出对未见过的推理任务的显著零样本泛化能力。消融研究验证了每个架构组件的关键贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将机器感知能力从简单的识别推向真正的认知理解，为机器人、人机交互等领域的更智能、更强大的AI系统铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 当前视频理解模型在识别“发生了什么”方面表现出色，但在因果推理和未来预测等高级认知任务方面表现不佳，其局限性在于缺乏常识性世界知识。为了弥合这种认知差距，我们提出了一个新颖的框架，将强大的视觉基础模型（VFM）用于深度视觉感知与作为知识驱动的推理核心的大型语言模型（LLM）协同融合。我们的关键技术创新在于一个复杂的融合模块，该模块受到Q-Former架构的启发，将复杂的时空和以物体为中心的视觉特征提炼成简洁的、与语言对齐的表示。这使得LLM能够有效地将其推理过程 grounding 在直接的视觉证据上。该模型通过一个两阶段策略进行训练，首先在视频-文本数据上进行大规模对齐预训练，然后在一个精心设计的、旨在激发高级推理和预测技能的数据集上进行有针对性的指令微调。广泛的实验表明，我们的模型在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。值得注意的是，它对未见的推理任务展现出显著的零样本泛化能力，并且我们深入的消融研究验证了每个架构组件的关键贡献。这项工作将机器感知能力从简单的识别推向真正的认知理解，为机器人、人机交互及其他领域的更智能、更强大的AI系统铺平了道路。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的视频理解框架，通过融合视觉基础模型（VFM）和大型语言模型（LLM）来解决现有模型在因果推理和未来预测方面的不足。该框架的核心是一个Q-Former启发的融合模块，它能将视觉信息转化为LLM可理解的表示，从而实现基于视觉证据的推理。模型通过大规模预训练和指令微调进行训练，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，同时表现出良好的零样本泛化能力，预示着AI在高级认知任务方面的发展前景。
AI.keywords: 视频理解, 因果推理, 未来预测, 视觉基础模型, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地结合了视觉基础模型和大型语言模型，解决了视频理解中的一个关键挑战——高级认知任务（如因果推理和预测）。其创新的融合模块设计是亮点，能够有效地将视觉信息传递给LLM，实现了真正的“视觉接地”推理。模型在多个基准上的优异表现和零样本泛化能力证明了该方法的有效性。然而，对于融合模块的具体细节和LLM在推理过程中如何处理不确定性信息的机制，可以进一步探讨。该研究为开发更具认知能力的AI系统奠定了重要基础。

title: The Primacy of Magnitude in Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) offers a parameter-efficient paradigm for tuning large models. While recent spectral initialization methods improve convergence and performance over the naive "Noise & Zeros" scheme, their extra computational and storage overhead undermines efficiency. In this paper, we establish update magnitude as the fundamental driver of LoRA performance and propose LoRAM, a magnitude-driven "Basis & Basis" initialization scheme that matches spectral methods without their inefficiencies. Our key contributions are threefold: (i) Magnitude of weight updates determines convergence. We prove low-rank structures intrinsically bound update magnitudes, unifying hyperparameter tuning in learning rate, scaling factor, and initialization as mechanisms to optimize magnitude regulation. (ii) Spectral initialization succeeds via magnitude amplification. We demystify that the presumed knowledge-driven benefit of the spectral component essentially arises from the boost in the weight update magnitude. (iii) A novel and compact initialization strategy, LoRAM, scales deterministic orthogonal bases using pretrained weight magnitudes to simulate spectral gains. Extensive experiments show that LoRAM serves as a strong baseline, retaining the full efficiency of LoRA while matching or outperforming spectral initialization across benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 低秩适应中的幅度优先性
AI.tldr: LoRA性能的关键在于权重更新的幅度，而不是复杂的谱初始化。我们提出了LoRAM，一个简单的“Basis & Basis”初始化方法，它直接通过幅度缩放实现与谱方法同等的性能，同时保持了LoRA的最高效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的谱初始化方法虽然提高了LoRA的收敛性和性能，但它们带来了额外的计算和存储开销，损害了LoRA的效率。因此，需要一种能在不牺牲效率的前提下提升性能的初始化方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种称为LoRAM的“Basis & Basis”初始化方案，它通过使用预训练权重（pretrained weight magnitudes）的幅度来缩放确定性正交基（deterministic orthogonal bases），以直接模拟谱初始化带来的幅度放大效果。
AI.result: LoRAM作为一种强大的基线，在保持LoRA完整效率的同时，在各项基准测试中与或超越了谱初始化方法。研究证明了权重更新的幅度是决定LoRA收敛性的根本因素。
AI.conclusion: LoRAM作为一种新颖且紧凑的初始化策略，通过使用预训练权重的幅度来缩放确定性正交基，成功模拟了谱方法的增益，并在保持LoRA完整效率的同时，在各项基准测试中与或超越了谱初始化方法。
AI.translation: 低秩适应（LoRA）提供了一种参数高效的调优大型模型范式。虽然最近的谱初始化方法比天真的“噪声与零”方案提高了收敛性和性能，但它们额外的计算和存储开销损害了效率。在本文中，我们确立了更新幅度是LoRA性能的基本驱动力，并提出了一种幅度驱动的“Basis & Basis”初始化方案LoRAM，该方案在不引入谱方法低效性的情况下，匹配了谱方法的性能。我们的主要贡献有三点：（i）权重更新的幅度决定了收敛性。我们证明了低秩结构固有地限制了更新幅度，将学习率、缩放因子和初始化这三种超参数调优统一为优化幅度调节的机制。（ii）谱初始化通过幅度放大而成功。我们揭示了谱分量所谓的“知识驱动”益处实际上源于权重更新幅度的提升。（iii）一种新颖且紧凑的初始化策略LoRAM，使用预训练权重的幅度来缩放确定性正交基，以模拟谱增益。广泛的实验表明，LoRAM是一个强有力的基线，在保持LoRA完整效率的同时，在各项基准测试中与或超越了谱初始化方法。
AI.summary: 本文认为低秩适应（LoRA）性能的关键驱动力是权重更新的幅度，而非复杂的谱初始化。作者提出了LoRAM，一种“Basis & Basis”初始化方案，它通过利用预训练权重的幅度来缩放正交基，从而高效地实现与谱方法相当的性能增益，同时保持了LoRA原有的计算和存储效率。
AI.keywords: 低秩适应, LoRA, 权重更新幅度, 初始化, 谱初始化
AI.comments: 该研究的核心创新在于将LoRA性能的关键驱动力从复杂的谱初始化转移到更新权重本身的幅度（Magnitude），并提出了一个高效的“Basis & Basis”初始化方案LoRAM来直接调控幅度，从而在保持LoRA效率的同时匹敌甚至超越了更复杂的谱方法。这是一个对LoRA机理的重要洞察和实用改进。

title: Precomputed Dominant Resource Fairness
summary: Although resource allocation is a well studied problem in computer science, until the prevalence of distributed systems, such as computing clouds and data centres, the question had been addressed predominantly for single resource type scenarios. At the beginning of the last decade, with the introuction of Dominant Resource Fairness, the studies of the resource allocation problem has finally extended to the multiple resource type scenarios. Dominant Resource Fairness is a solution, addressing the problem of fair allocation of multiple resource types, among users with heterogeneous demands. Based on Max-min Fairness, which is a well established algorithm in the literature for allocating resources in the single resource type scenarios, Dominant Resource Fairness generalises the scheme to the multiple resource case. It has a number of desirable properties that makes it preferable over alternatives, such as Sharing Incentive, Envy-Freeness, Pareto Efficiency, and Strategy Proofness, and as such, it is widely adopted in distributed systems. In the present study, we revisit the original study, and analyse the structure of the algorithm in closer view, to come up with an alternative algorithm, which approximates the Dominant Resource Fairness allocation in fewer steps. We name the new algorithm Precomputed Dominant Resource Fairness, after its main working principle.

AI.title_translation: 预计算支配资源公平性
AI.tldr: 研究人员分析了广泛用于多资源公平分配的DRF算法，并开发了一种名为PDRF的新算法，它能用更少的计算步骤近似实现DRF的公平分配。
AI.motivation: 解决在分布式系统（如云计算和数据中心）中，现有Dominant Resource Fairness（DRF）算法在多资源公平分配中可能存在的计算步骤过多的问题。
AI.method: 通过对原始DRF算法的结构进行深入分析，提出了一种可以在更少步骤内近似DRF分配的新算法——预计算支配资源公平性（Precomputed Dominant Resource Fairness）。
AI.result: 提出了一种名为“预计算支配资源公平性”（Precomputed Dominant Resource Fairness）的新算法，该算法能够以更少的步骤近似Dominant Resource Fairness的分配结果。
AI.translation: 尽管资源分配是计算机科学中一个研究透彻的问题，但在分布式系统（如计算云和数据中心）普及之前，这个问题主要针对单一资源类型场景。在过去十年的开始，随着支配资源公平性（Dominant Resource Fairness, DRF）的引入，资源分配的研究终于扩展到多资源类型场景。DRF是一种解决方案，用于解决在具有异构需求的用户之间公平分配多种资源的问题。基于Max-min公平性（一种在单资源类型场景中分配资源的成熟算法），DRF将该方案推广到多资源情况。它具有许多理想的特性，使其优于替代方案，例如共享激励性、无嫉妒性、帕累托最优性和策略可证明性，因此在分布式系统中被广泛采用。在本研究中，我们重新审视了原始研究，并更深入地分析了该算法的结构，以便提出一种替代算法，该算法能在更少的步骤内近似Dominant Resource Fairness的分配。我们根据其主要工作原理将新算法命名为“预计算支配资源公平性”（Precomputed Dominant Resource Fairness）。
AI.summary: 本文针对分布式系统中多资源公平分配问题，回顾了广泛应用的Dominant Resource Fairness (DRF) 算法。研究者通过深入分析DRF的结构，提出了一种新的、更高效的近似算法——Precomputed Dominant Resource Fairness (PDRF)，该算法能够在更少的步骤内达到与DRF相近的资源分配效果。
AI.keywords: 资源分配, 支配资源公平性, 多资源, Max-min公平性, 预计算
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种近似于DRF的新算法，旨在减少计算步骤。其重要性在于为多资源公平分配问题提供了一个更高效的解决方案。局限性是它是一个近似算法，可能无法完全达到DRF的精确公平性。

title: Cost-aware Stopping for Bayesian Optimization
summary: In automated machine learning, scientific discovery, and other applications of Bayesian optimization, deciding when to stop evaluating expensive black-box functions in a cost-aware manner is an important but underexplored practical consideration. A natural performance metric for this purpose is the cost-adjusted simple regret, which captures the trade-off between solution quality and cumulative evaluation cost. While several heuristic or adaptive stopping rules have been proposed, they lack guarantees ensuring stopping before incurring excessive function evaluation costs. We propose a principled cost-aware stopping rule for Bayesian optimization that adapts to varying evaluation costs without heuristic tuning. Our rule is grounded in a theoretical connection to state-of-the-art cost-aware acquisition functions, namely the Pandora's Box Gittins Index (PBGI) and log expected improvement per cost (LogEIPC). We prove a theoretical guarantee bounding the expected cost-adjusted simple regret incurred by our stopping rule when paired with either acquisition function. Across synthetic and empirical tasks, including hyperparameter optimization and neural architecture size search, pairing our stopping rule with PBGI or LogEIPC usually matches or outperforms other acquisition-function--stopping-rule pairs in terms of cost-adjusted simple regret.

title: Solution of Least Squares Problems with Randomized Preconditioned Normal Equations
summary: We consider the solution of full column-rank least squares problems by means of normal equations that are preconditioned, symmetrically or non-symmetrically, with a randomized preconditioner. With an effective preconditioner, the solutions from the preconditioned normal equations are almost as accurate as those from the QR-based Matlab backslash (mldivide) command -- even for highly illconditioned matrices. This means the accuracy of the preconditioned normal equations depends on the residual of the original least squares problem. We present non-intuitive but realistic perturbation bounds for the relative error in the computed solutions and show that, with an effective preconditioner, these bounds are essentially equal to the perturbation bound for the original least squares problem. Probabilitistic condition number bounds corroborate the effectiveness of the randomized preconditioner computed with small amounts of sampling.

AI.title_translation: 随机预处理正规方程求解最小二乘问题
AI.tldr: 使用随机预处理正规方程可以高效且高精度地求解最小二乘问题，精度可媲美QR分解，尤其在病态情况下表现良好。
AI.motivation: 在最小二乘问题求解中，希望通过预处理正规方程的方法，在保持高精度的同时，获得接近于QR分解（如Matlab的mldivide）的解的精度，即使面对高度病态的矩阵。
AI.method: 使用随机预处理（对称或非对称）来处理满秩最小二乘问题的正规方程，并推导出计算解的相对误差的非直观但实际的扰动界限。
AI.result: 使用有效的预处理器，预处理正规方程的解的精度几乎与QR分解（Matlab backslash）的解一样准确，并且计算出的误差界限与原始最小二乘问题的误差界限基本相同。随机预处理器的有效性得到了概率条件数界限的佐证。
AI.conclusion: 与有效预处理器一起，预处理正规方程的误差界限本质上等于原始最小二乘问题的扰动界限。
AI.translation: 我们研究了利用随机预处理（对称或非对称）的正规方程来求解满秩最小二乘问题。使用有效的预处理器，预处理正规方程的解的精度几乎与基于QR的Matlab反斜杠（mldivide）命令的解一样准确——即使对于高度病态的矩阵。这意味着预处理正规方程的精度取决于原始最小二乘问题的残差。我们为计算解的相对误差提供了非直观但实际的扰动界限，并证明了使用有效预处理器时，这些界限基本上等于原始最小二乘问题的扰动界限。概率条件数界限证实了使用少量采样计算出的随机预处理器的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了使用随机预处理（对称或非对称）的正规方程来求解满秩最小二乘问题。研究表明，使用有效的预处理器，其解的精度可以与基于QR分解的方法（如Matlab mldivide）相媲美，即使对于高度病态的矩阵。研究还提供了计算解的相对误差的实际扰动界限，并证明了这些界限与原始问题的界限相当。
AI.keywords: 最小二乘问题,正规方程,随机预处理,病态矩阵,误差界限
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于使用随机预处理技术来提高正规方程求解最小二乘问题的精度，尤其是在处理病态矩阵时，其结果能接近于QR分解的精度。其重要性在于提供了一种计算上更高效且精度有保证的求解方法。局限性在于对“有效预处理器”的依赖性。

title: Think, Act, Learn: A Framework for Autonomous Robotic Agents using Closed-Loop Large Language Models
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into robotics has unlocked unprecedented capabilities in high-level task planning. However, most current systems operate in an open-loop fashion, where LLMs act as one-shot planners, rendering them brittle and unable to adapt to unforeseen circumstances in dynamic physical environments. To overcome this limitation, this paper introduces the "Think, Act, Learn" (T-A-L) framework, a novel architecture that enables an embodied agent to autonomously learn and refine its policies through continuous interaction. Our framework establishes a closed-loop cycle where an LLM first "thinks" by decomposing high-level commands into actionable plans. The robot then "acts" by executing these plans while gathering rich, multimodal sensory feedback. Critically, the "learn" module processes this feedback to facilitate LLM-driven self-reflection, allowing the agent to perform causal analysis on its failures and generate corrective strategies. These insights are stored in an experiential memory to guide future planning cycles. We demonstrate through extensive experiments in both simulation and the real world that our T-A-L agent significantly outperforms baseline methods, including open-loop LLMs, Behavioral Cloning, and traditional Reinforcement Learning. Our framework achieves over a 97% success rate on complex, long-horizon tasks, converges to a stable policy in an average of just 9 trials, and exhibits remarkable generalization to unseen tasks. This work presents a significant step towards developing more robust, adaptive, and truly autonomous robotic agents.

title: Inducing Causal World Models in LLMs for Zero-Shot Physical Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), despite their advanced linguistic capabilities, fundamentally lack an intuitive understanding of physical dynamics, which limits their effectiveness in real-world scenarios that require causal reasoning. In this paper, we introduce Causal World Model Induction (CWMI), a novel framework designed to embed an explicit model of causal physics within an LLM. Our approach incorporates a dedicated Causal Physics Module (CPM) and a new training objective called Causal Intervention Loss, encouraging the model to learn cause-and-effect relationships from multimodal data. By training the model to predict the outcomes of hypothetical interventions instead of merely capturing statistical correlations, CWMI develops a robust internal representation of physical laws. Experimental results show that CWMI significantly outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs on zero-shot physical reasoning tasks, including the PIQA benchmark and our newly proposed PhysiCa-Bench dataset. These findings demonstrate that inducing a causal world model is a critical step toward more reliable and generalizable AI systems.

title: AlignFreeNet: Is Cross-Modal Pre-Alignment Necessary? An End-to-End Alignment-Free Lightweight Network for Visible-Infrared Object Detection
summary: Cross-modal misalignments, such as spatial offsets, resolution discrepancies, and semantic deficiencies, frequently occur in visible-infrared object detection (VI-OD). To mitigate this, existing methods are typically adapted into an alignment-based fusion paradigm, in which an explicit pixel- or feature-level alignment module is inserted before cross-modal fusion. However, pixel-level alignment struggles to cope with severe or mixed misalignments, whereas feature-level alignment often introduces undesirable noise into fused representations under such conditions, ultimately limiting detection performance. In this paper, we propose a novel alignment-free network (AlignFreeNet) for VI-OD. Differing from prior methods, AlignFreeNet abandons any explicit alignment and instead adopts an alignment-free fusion paradigm. Specifically, AlignFreeNet comprises two core modules: variation-guided cross-modal compensation (VCC) and frequency-guided cross-modal fusion (FCF). VCC adaptively feeds the compensated information derived from cross-modal discrepancies back into each modality, enhancing visible and infrared representations without the noise caused by explicit alignment. FCF achieves robust cross-modal fusion by suppressing task-irrelevant redundancy via frequency-domain gating, effectively mitigating noise introduced in the process. Moreover, VCC and FCF jointly exploit low- and high-frequency cues to preserve foreground contours in fused representations, effectively mitigating cross-modal blending caused by severe mixed misalignments. Extensive evaluations on DVTOD, M3FD, and DroneVehicle demonstrate that our AlignFreeNet achieves state-of-the-art performance under severe mixed misalignment conditions, highlighting its robustness and generalization.

title: Efficient Neural Combinatorial Optimization Solver for the Min-max Heterogeneous Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
summary: Numerous Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) solvers have been proposed to address Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs). However, most of these solvers focus exclusively on single-vehicle VRP variants, overlooking the more realistic min-max Heterogeneous Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (MMHCVRP), which involves multiple vehicles. Existing MMHCVRP solvers typically select a vehicle and its next node to visit at each decoding step, but often make myopic decoding decisions and overlook key properties of MMHCVRP, including local topological relationships, vehicle permutation invariance, and node symmetry, resulting in suboptimal performance. To better address these limitations, we propose ECHO, an efficient NCO solver. First, ECHO exploits the proposed dual-modality node encoder to capture local topological relationships among nodes. Subsequently, to mitigate myopic decisions, ECHO employs the proposed Parameter-Free Cross-Attention mechanism to prioritize the vehicle selected in the preceding decoding step. Finally, leveraging vehicle permutation invariance and node symmetry, we introduce a tailored data augment strategy for MMHCVRP to stabilize the Reinforcement Learning training process. To assess the performance of ECHO, we conduct extensive experiments. The experimental results demonstrate that ECHO outperforms state-of-the-art NCO solvers across varying numbers of vehicles and nodes, and exhibits well-performing generalization across both scales and distribution patterns. Finally, ablation studies validate the effectiveness of all proposed methods.

title: Hierarchies within TFNP: building blocks and collapses
summary:
In all well-studied $\mathsf{TFNP}$ subclasses (e.g. $\mathsf{PPA}, \mathsf{PPP}$ etc.), the canonical complete problem takes as input a polynomial-size circuit $C: \{ 0, 1\}^n \rightarrow \{ 0, 1\}^m$ whose input-output behavior implicitly encodes an exponentially large object $G$, i.e. $C$ is the succinct (polynomial-size) representation of the exponential size object $G$. The goal is to find some particular substructure in $G$ which can be confirmed in polynomial time using queries to $C$.
  We initiate the study of classes of the form $\mathsf{A}^{\mathsf{B}}$ where both $\mathsf{A}$ and $\mathsf{B}$ are $\mathsf{TFNP}$ subclasses. In particular, we define complete problems for these classes that take as input a circuit $C$ which is allowed oracle gates to another $\mathsf{TFNP}$ class.
  Beyond introducing definitions for $\mathsf{TFNP}$ oracle problems, our specific technical contributions include showing that several $\mathsf{TFNP}$ subclasses are self-low and hence their corresponding hierarchies collapse. In particular, $\mathsf{PPA^{PPA}} = \mathsf{PPA}$, $\mathsf{PLS^{PLS}} = \mathsf{PLS}$, and $\mathsf{LOSSY^{LOSSY}} = \mathsf{LOSSY}$. As an immediate consequence, we derive that when reducing to $\mathsf{PPA}$, one can always assume access to $\mathsf{PPA}$ -- and therefore factoring -- oracle gates.
  In addition to introducing a variety of hierarchies within $\mathsf{TFNP}$ that merit study in their own right, these ideas introduce a novel approach for classifying computational problems within $\mathsf{TFNP}$ and proving black-box separations. For example, we observe that the problem of deterministically generating large prime numbers, which has long resisted classification in a $\mathsf{TFNP}$ subclass, is in $\mathsf{PPP^{\mathsf{PPP}}}$ under the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis.

title: BeDKD: Backdoor Defense based on Dynamic Knowledge Distillation and Directional Mapping Modulator
summary: Although existing backdoor defenses have gained success in mitigating backdoor attacks, they still face substantial challenges. In particular, most of them rely on large amounts of clean data to weaken the backdoor mapping but generally struggle with residual trigger effects, resulting in persistently high attack success rates (ASR). Therefore, in this paper, we propose a novel Backdoor defense method based on Directional mapping module and adversarial Knowledge Distillation (BeDKD), which balances the trade-off between defense effectiveness and model performance using a small amount of clean and poisoned data. We first introduce a directional mapping module to identify poisoned data, which destroys clean mapping while keeping backdoor mapping on a small set of flipped clean data. Then, the adversarial knowledge distillation is designed to reinforce clean mapping and suppress backdoor mapping through a cycle iteration mechanism between trust and punish distillations using clean and identified poisoned data. We conduct experiments to mitigate mainstream attacks on three datasets, and experimental results demonstrate that BeDKD surpasses the state-of-the-art defenses and reduces the ASR by 98% without significantly reducing the CACC. Our code are available in https://github.com/CAU-ISS-Lab/Backdoor-Attack-Defense-LLMs/tree/main/BeDKD.

title: Two operator splitting methods for three-dimensional stochastic Maxwell equations with multiplicative noise
summary: In this paper, we develop two energy-preserving splitting methods for solving three-dimensional stochastic Maxwell equations driven by multiplicative noise. We use operator splitting methods to decouple stochastic Maxwell equations into simple one-dimensional subsystems and construct two stochastic splitting methods, Splitting Method I and Splitting Method II, through a combination of spatial compact difference methods and the midpoint rule in time discretization for the deterministic parts, and exact unitary analytical solutions for the stochastic parts. Theoretical proofs show that both methods strictly preserve the discrete energy conservation law. Finally, numerical experiments fully verify the energy conservation of the methods and demonstrate that the temporal convergence order of the two splitting methods is first-order.

title: Convolutional autoencoders for the reconstruction of three-dimensional interfacial multiphase flows
summary: We present a systematic investigation of convolutional autoencoders for the reduced-order representation of three-dimensional interfacial multiphase flows. Focusing on the reconstruction of phase indicators, we examine how the choice of interface representation, including sharp, diffuse, and level-set formulations, impacts reconstruction accuracy across a range of interface complexities. Training and validation are performed using both synthetic datasets with controlled geometric complexity and high-fidelity simulations of multiphase homogeneous isotropic turbulence. We show that the interface representation plays a critical role in autoencoder performance. Excessively sharp interfaces lead to the loss of small-scale features, while overly diffuse interfaces degrade overall accuracy. Across all datasets and metrics considered, a moderately diffuse interface provides the best balance between preserving fine-scale structures and achieving accurate reconstructions. These findings elucidate key limitations and best practices for dimensionality reduction of multiphase flows using autoencoders. By clarifying how interface representations interact with the inductive biases of convolutional neural networks, this work lays the foundation for decoupling the training of autoencoders for accurate state compression from the training of surrogate models for temporal forecasting or input-output prediction in latent space.

title: StepFun-Formalizer: Unlocking the Autoformalization Potential of LLMs through Knowledge-Reasoning Fusion
comments: AAAI 2026 Oral. Extended version with full appendix, 25 pages, 17 figures
summary: Autoformalization aims to translate natural-language mathematical statements into a formal language. While LLMs have accelerated progress in this area, existing methods still suffer from low accuracy. We identify two key abilities for effective autoformalization: comprehensive mastery of formal-language domain knowledge, and reasoning capability of natural language problem understanding and informal-formal alignment. Without the former, a model cannot identify the correct formal objects; without the latter, it struggles to interpret real-world contexts and map them precisely into formal expressions. To address these gaps, we introduce ThinkingF, a data synthesis and training pipeline that improves both abilities. First, we construct two datasets: one by distilling and selecting large-scale examples rich in formal knowledge, and another by generating informal-to-formal reasoning trajectories guided by expert-designed templates. We then apply SFT and RLVR with these datasets to further fuse and refine the two abilities. The resulting 7B and 32B models exhibit both comprehensive formal knowledge and strong informal-to-formal reasoning. Notably, StepFun-Formalizer-32B achieves SOTA BEq@1 scores of 40.5% on FormalMATH-Lite and 26.7% on ProverBench, surpassing all prior general-purpose and specialized models.

title: SIFThinker: Spatially-Aware Image Focus for Visual Reasoning
summary: Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still face significant challenges in complex visual tasks (e.g., spatial understanding, fine-grained perception). Prior methods have tried to incorporate visual reasoning, however, they fail to leverage attention correction with spatial cues to iteratively refine their focus on prompt-relevant regions. In this paper, we introduce SIFThinker, a spatially-aware "think-with-images" framework that mimics human visual perception. Specifically, SIFThinker enables attention correcting and image region focusing by interleaving depth-enhanced bounding boxes and natural language. Our contributions are twofold: First, we introduce a reverse-expansion-forward-inference strategy that facilitates the generation of interleaved image-text chains of thought for process-level supervision, which in turn leads to the construction of the SIF-50K dataset. Besides, we propose GRPO-SIF, a reinforced training paradigm that integrates depth-informed visual grounding into a unified reasoning pipeline, teaching the model to dynamically correct and focus on prompt-relevant regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SIFThinker outperforms state-of-the-art methods in spatial understanding and fine-grained visual perception, while maintaining strong general capabilities, highlighting the effectiveness of our method. title: DySK-Attn: A Framework for Efficient, Real-Time Knowledge Updating in Large Language Models via Dynamic Sparse Knowledge Attention
comments: Preprint; 7 figures, 3 tables, 1 algorithm; v1. Code and data will be released
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) suffer from a critical limitation: their knowledge is static and quickly becomes outdated. Retraining these massive models is computationally prohibitive, while existing knowledge editing techniques can be slow and may introduce unforeseen side effects. To address this, we propose DySK-Attn, a novel framework that enables LLMs to efficiently integrate real-time knowledge from a dynamic external source. Our approach synergizes an LLM with a dynamic Knowledge Graph (KG) that can be updated instantaneously. The core of our framework is a sparse knowledge attention mechanism, which allows the LLM to perform a coarse-to-fine grained search, efficiently identifying and focusing on a small, highly relevant subset of facts from the vast KG. This mechanism avoids the high computational cost of dense attention over the entire knowledge base and mitigates noise from irrelevant information. We demonstrate through extensive experiments on time-sensitive question-answering tasks that DySK-Attn significantly outperforms strong baselines, including standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and model editing techniques, in both factual accuracy for updated knowledge and computational efficiency. Our framework offers a scalable and effective solution for building LLMs that can stay current with the ever-changing world.

title: CP-Agent: Agentic Constraint Programming
summary:
Translating natural language into formal constraint models requires expertise in the problem domain and modeling frameworks. To investigate whether constraint modeling benefits from agentic workflows, we introduce CP-Agent, a Python coding agent using the ReAct framework with a persistent IPython kernel. Domain knowledge is provided through a project prompt of under 50 lines. The agent iteratively executes code, observes the solver's feedback, and refines models based on the execution results.
  We evaluate CP-Agent on CP-Bench's 101 constraint programming problems. We clarified the benchmark to address systematic ambiguities in problem specifications and errors in ground-truth models. On the clarified benchmark, CP-Agent solves all 101 problems. Ablation studies indicate that minimal guidance outperforms detailed procedural scaffolding, and that explicit task management tools have mixed effects on focused modeling tasks.

title: Computational Economics in Large Language Models: Exploring Model Behavior and Incentive Design under Resource Constraints
comments: Preprint; 7 figures, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. Experiments on GLUE (MNLI, STS-B, CoLA) and WikiText-103 with BERT-base; evaluation includes FLOPS, latency, Gini and entropy metrics
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are limited by substantial computational cost. We introduce a "computational economics" framework that treats an LLM as an internal economy of resource-constrained agents (attention heads and neuron blocks) that must allocate scarce computation to maximize task utility. First, we show empirically that when computation is scarce, standard LLMs reallocate attention toward high-value tokens while preserving accuracy. Building on this observation, we propose an incentive-driven training paradigm that augments the task loss with a differentiable computation cost term, encouraging sparse and efficient activations. On GLUE (MNLI, STS-B, CoLA) and WikiText-103, the method yields a family of models that trace a Pareto frontier and consistently dominate post-hoc pruning; for a similar accuracy we obtain roughly a forty percent reduction in FLOPS and lower latency, together with more interpretable attention patterns. These results indicate that economic principles offer a principled route to designing efficient, adaptive, and more transparent LLMs under strict resource constraints.

title: ChatENV: An Interactive Vision-Language Model for Sensor-Guided Environmental Monitoring and Scenario Simulation
summary: Understanding environmental changes from remote sensing imagery is vital for climate resilience, urban planning, and ecosystem monitoring. Yet, current vision language models (VLMs) overlook causal signals from environmental sensors, rely on single-source captions prone to stylistic bias, and lack interactive scenario-based reasoning. We present ChatENV, the first interactive VLM that jointly reasons over satellite image pairs and real-world sensor data. Our framework: (i) creates a 177k-image dataset forming 152k temporal pairs across 62 land-use classes in 197 countries with rich sensor metadata (e.g., temperature, PM10, CO); (ii) annotates data using GPT4o and Gemini 2.0 for stylistic and semantic diversity; and (iii) fine-tunes Qwen-2.5-VL using efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters for chat purposes. ChatENV achieves strong performance in temporal and "what-if" reasoning (e.g., BERTF1 0.902) and rivals or outperforms state-of-the-art temporal models, while supporting interactive scenario-based analysis. This positions ChatENV as a powerful tool for grounded, sensor-aware environmental monitoring.

title: The Cultural Gene of Large Language Models: A Study on the Impact of Cross-Corpus Training on Model Values and Biases
comments: 10 pages, 5 figures, IEEE conference format, submitted to [Conference Name]
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are deployed globally, yet their underlying cultural and ethical assumptions remain underexplored. We propose the notion of a "cultural gene" -- a systematic value orientation that LLMs inherit from their training corpora -- and introduce a Cultural Probe Dataset (CPD) of 200 prompts targeting two classic cross-cultural dimensions: Individualism-Collectivism (IDV) and Power Distance (PDI). Using standardized zero-shot prompts, we compare a Western-centric model (GPT-4) and an Eastern-centric model (ERNIE Bot). Human annotation shows significant and consistent divergence across both dimensions. GPT-4 exhibits individualistic and low-power-distance tendencies (IDV score approx 1.21; PDI score approx -1.05), while ERNIE Bot shows collectivistic and higher-power-distance tendencies (IDV approx -0.89; PDI approx 0.76); differences are statistically significant (p < 0.001). We further compute a Cultural Alignment Index (CAI) against Hofstede's national scores and find GPT-4 aligns more closely with the USA (e.g., IDV CAI approx 0.91; PDI CAI approx 0.88) whereas ERNIE Bot aligns more closely with China (IDV CAI approx 0.85; PDI CAI approx 0.81). Qualitative analyses of dilemma resolution and authority-related judgments illustrate how these orientations surface in reasoning. Our results support the view that LLMs function as statistical mirrors of their cultural corpora and motivate culturally aware evaluation and deployment to avoid algorithmic cultural hegemony.

title: Beyond Trade-offs: A Unified Framework for Privacy, Robustness, and Communication Efficiency in Federated Learning
comments: This paper is an extended version of "Fed-DPRoC: Communication-Efficient Differentially Private and Robust Federated Learning", presented at the 3rd IEEE International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2025)
summary: We propose Fed-DPRoC, a novel federated learning framework designed to jointly provide differential privacy (DP), Byzantine robustness, and communication efficiency. Central to our approach is the concept of robust-compatible compression, which allows reducing the bi-directional communication overhead without undermining the robustness of the aggregation. We instantiate our framework as RobAJoL, which integrates the Johnson-Lindenstrauss (JL)-based compression mechanism with robust averaging for robustness. Our theoretical analysis establishes the compatibility of JL transform with robust averaging, ensuring that RobAJoL maintains robustness guarantees, satisfies DP, and substantially reduces communication overhead. We further present simulation results on CIFAR-10, Fashion MNIST, and FEMNIST, validating our theoretical claims. We compare RobAJoL with a state-of-the-art communication-efficient and robust FL scheme augmented with DP for a fair comparison, demonstrating that RobAJoL outperforms existing methods in terms of robustness and utility under different Byzantine attacks.

title: Webly-Supervised Image Manipulation Localization via Category-Aware Auto-Annotation
summary: Images manipulated by image editing tools can mislead viewers and pose significant risks to social security. However, accurately localizing manipulated image regions remains challenging due to the severe scarcity of high-quality annotated data, which is laborious to create. To address this, we propose a novel approach that mitigates data scarcity by leveraging readily available web data. We utilize a large collection of manually forged images from the web, as well as automatically generated annotations derived from a simpler auxiliary task, constrained image manipulation localization.Specifically, we introduce CAAAv2, a novel auto-annotation framework that operates on a category-aware, prior-feature-denoising paradigm that notably reduces task complexity. To further ensure annotation reliability, we propose QES, a novel metric that filters out low-quality annotations. Combining CAAAv2 and QES, we construct MIMLv2, a large-scale, diverse, and high-quality dataset containing 246,212 manually forged images with pixel-level mask annotations. This is over 120 times larger than existing handcrafted datasets like IMD20. Additionally, we introduce Object Jitter, a technique that further enhances model training by generating high-quality manipulation artifacts. Building on these advances, we develop Web-IML, a new model designed to effectively leverage web-scale supervision for the task of image manipulation localization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach substantially alleviates the data scarcity problem and significantly improves the performance of various models on multiple real-world forgery benchmarks. With the proposed web supervision, our Web-IML achieves a striking performance gain of 31% and surpasses the previous state-of-the-art SparseViT by 21.6 average IoU points. The dataset and code will be released at https://github.com/qcf-568/MIML.
